translations.source: “Yanzu muna bera mai watanni 4 wadanda ba su da ciwon sukari ba wadanda ke da suke fama da ciwon sukari,” in ji shi.
translations.reference: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.hypothesis: “We currently serve a four-month supply chain for non-diabetic and diabetic patients,” he said.

translations.source: Dokta Ehud Ur, farfesan magani a Jami’ar Dalhousie da ke Halifax, Nova Scotia kuma shugaban sashen likitanci da bangaren kimiyya na kungiyar masu ciwon sikari ta Kanada ya yi gargadin cewa har yanzu binciken yana kan farkonsa.
translations.reference: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Ehud Ur, Professor of Medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and Chief Scientific Officer of the Canadian Diabetes Association, warned that the study is only in its early stages.

translations.source: Kamar wasu ƙwararrun, yana da shakkun cewa ko za a iya warkar da ciwon sukari, inda ya bayyana cewa sakamakon bincike ba shi da alaƙa da mutanen da tuni su ke da nau’in ciwon sukari na 1.
translations.reference: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.hypothesis: Like many other health professionals, he is doubtful that diabetes can be cured, stating that the results of the study are only applicable to people with type 2 diabetes.

translations.source: A ranar Litinin, Sara Danius, sakatariyar dindindin ta Kwamitin Adabi na kungiyar nagartattu a Kwalejin Nazarin Sweden, ta sanar a bainar jama'a yayin wani shirin rediyo a Sveriges Radio a Sweden kwamitin, ba zai iya kaiwa ga Bob Dylan kai tsaye ba game da lashe kyautar Nobel ta 2016 a Adabi, ta yi watsi da ita kokarinta na isa gare shi.
translations.reference: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.hypothesis: On Monday, Sara Danius, the permanent secretary of the Swedish Academy's literature prize committee, announced on a Swedish radio show, Sveriges Radio, that the committee had been unable to reach Bob Dylan directly regarding the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, and had therefore declined to pursue him.

translations.source: Danius ya ce, “Yanzu haka ba mwa yin komi. Na kira na kuma aika emails zuwa abokan aikinsa na kusa na kuma anshi amsoshi masu kyau. A yanzu haka, wannan bai isa ba.”
translations.reference: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.hypothesis: "We're not doing anything about it now. I had already called and emailed my local representatives and gotten positive feedback. For now, that's enough," Dinius said.

translations.source: A baya, Shugaban kamfanin Ring, Jamie Siminoff, ya bayyana cewa kamfanin ya fara lokacin da ba a jiyo sauti kararrawar jikin ƙofar sa daga shagonsa a cikin garejinsa.
translations.reference: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.hypothesis: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, explained that the company got the idea when he didn't hear his garage door close from inside his house.

translations.source: Ya ce, ya gina ƙararrawar ƙofa ta WiFi.
translations.reference: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.hypothesis: He said he built a wireless router from scratch.

translations.source: Siminoff yace ciniki ya karu baya futuwar sa ta 2013 a shinrin wasan kwaikwayin Shark Tank inda masu shirin suka ki biyan kudin sabuwar sana'ar.
translations.reference: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff said sales increased after his 2013 appearance on the American game show Shark Tank, despite the fact that the investors declined to fund his startup.

translations.source: A ƙarshen 2017, Siminoff ya bayyana a tashar telebijin mai sayarwa ta QVC.
translations.reference: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.hypothesis: At the end of 2017, Siminoff appeared on QVC.

translations.source: Ring ta kuma sasanta takardar kotu tsakanin wata kamfanin adawa na tsaro wato ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: Ring is also embroiled in a legal battle with security company ADT Corporation.

translations.source: Yayinda allurar gwaji rigakafi guda daya ta bayyana tana iya rage mutuwar cutar ta Ebola, har zuwa yanzu, babu wasu kwayoyi da aka nuna da suka dace da maganin cututtukan da suke kamuwa da su.
translations.reference: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.hypothesis: While one vaccine has been shown to reduce Ebola deaths, to date, no drug has been shown to be effective against people with Ebola infection.

translations.source: Wani hadaddiyar giyar, ZMapp, da farko ya nuna alƙawari a fagen, amma nazarin yau da kullun ya nuna cewa ba shi da fa'ida fiye da yadda ake neman hana mutuwa.
translations.reference: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.hypothesis: Another monoclonal antibody, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but subsequent studies indicated it was no more effective than the standard of care.

translations.source: a nan gwajin PALM, ZMapp yayi bauta a wajen kula, hakan na nufin masana fasaha sun yi amfani da shi a matsayin kasan idan ka kimanta da hanyoyin guda uku nashi.
translations.reference: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.hypothesis: In the PALM trial, ZMapp was used in a three-pronged approach.

translations.source: Masu wasan tsalle tsalle na Amurka sun goyi bayan wasikar kwamitin gasar olympic tare da yarda da cikakkiyar bukatar duk masu wasan olympic da su yada maganar samar da yanayi mara hadari ga dukkan yan wasanmu.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: The American team fully supports the plea from the Olympic Council and believes that all Olympians should be allowed to speak out for the safety of all athletes.

translations.source: Mun yarda da bayanin USOC cewa bukatun ƴan wasanmu da kungiyar mu, da wasanninsu, na iya zama mafi alheri ta ci gaba tare da canji mai ma'ana a cikin ƙungiyarmu, maimakon ƙaddamar da doka.
translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We believe the USOC’s statement that our athletes’ and our country’s best interests are best served by moving forward with a meaningful change in our organization’s governance, rather than protracted and disruptive legal proceedings.

translations.source: Kungiyan daki motsa jiki na USA na goyon bayan bincike mai zaman kanta wadda take zaton zata kara haske kan cin zarafi wadda wadanda suka tsira daga Larry Nassar suka bayana wadda ba a gano ba na tsawon lokaci kuma ke rungume da duk wani canji mai muhimmanci.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: The USAG is supporting an independent inquiry that it hopes will clarify the allegations of abuse made by the survivors of Larry Nassar, and any other allegations that have surfaced, and address any failures to protect.

translations.source: Gidan motsa jiki na Amurka da USOC suna da manufa ɗaya - sa wasan motsa jiki, da sauransu, ya zama mai aminci yadda zai yiwu ƴan wasa su bi mafarkinsu cikin aminci, tabbatacce kuma mai ba da ƙarfi.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: The United States Olympic & Paralympic Committee (USOPC) has one core mission: to ensure the safety of our nation’s athletes so they can pursue their Olympic and Paralympic dreams in a safe, positive, and empowering environment.

translations.source: A duk tsawon 1960, Brzezinski yayi ma John F. Kenedy aiki a matsayin mai bada shawara kuma yayi aiki da gwamnatin Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.reference: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.hypothesis: During the 1960s, Brzezinski served as a foreign policy advisor to John F. Kennedy and worked in the administration of Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: A yayin zabukan 1976 ya shawarci Carter kan manufofin kasashen waje, sannan ya zama mai ba da shawara kan Tsaro na kasa (NSA) daga 1977 zuwa 1981, ya gaji Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1976 election he advised Carter on foreign policy, and as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981 succeeded Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: kasancewarsa dan NSA, ya taimaka wa Carter a harkokin dokokin kasashen waje wajen kula da lamuran duniya, kamar Yarjejeniyar Camp David, 1978; daidaita alaƙar Amurka da China tana tunanin ƙarshen shekarun 1970; juyin juya halin Iran, wanda ya haifar da rikicin garkuwar da Iran, 1979; da mamayar Soviet a Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: As National Security Advisor, he helped guide U.S. foreign policy toward major international developments, including the Camp David Accords, 1978; the normalization of relations between the United States and China in the late 1970s; the Iranian revolution, which led to the Iranian hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan, 1979.

translations.source: Fin ɗin, da ke nuna Ryan Gosling da Emma Stone, ya sami shiga cikin duk manyan ɓangarorin gasar.
translations.reference: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.hypothesis: The film, starring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, has garnered critical acclaim and is considered a frontrunner in several major categories.

translations.source: Gosling da Stone sun sami shiga neman cikin kyautar Fitaccen Jarumi da Jaruma.
translations.reference: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling and Stone were also nominated for Best Actor and Actress respectively.

translations.source: Sauran zaɓin sun hada da Hoto Mafi Kyau, Darakta, Majigi, Tsara Tufafi, Gyaran fina-finai, Makin Asali, Tsara Shiri, Gyara Sauti, Haɗa Sauti da kuma Asalin Labari.
translations.reference: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.hypothesis: Other options include Photo Editor, Director Suite, Collage, Text on Video, Video Effects, Original Sound, Music, Voiceover, and Audio Editor.

translations.source: Waƙoƙi biyu daga fim, Audition (Wawaye Waɗanda Suke Mafarki) da Birnin Taurari, sun karɓi zaɓi don mafi kyawun waƙar asali. Lionsgate studio ta sami nadin 26 - fiye da kowane sauran ɗakunan studio.
translations.reference: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.hypothesis: Two songs from the film, "Audition (Wasurena Hoshi)" and "City of Stars", were nominated for Best Original Song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations – more than any other studio.

translations.source: A daren ranar Lahadi shugaban kasar Amurka Donald Trump a cikin wata sanarwa da aka fitar ta sanarwar sakataren, ya sanar da dakarun kasar Amurka zasu bar kasar Syria.
translations.reference: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.hypothesis: On Sunday night, US President Donald Trump announced in a tweet that he was ordering the withdrawal of American troops from Syria.

translations.source: An bayar da sanarwar ce bayan Trump ya yi ganawa ta wayar salula da Shugaban Turkiyya Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
translations.reference: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.hypothesis: The announcement was made after a phone call between Trump and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

translations.source: Haka kuma Turkiyya za ta karbi aikin gadin mayakan ISIS da aka kama waɗanda, sanarwar ta ce, kasashen Turai suka ki mayar da su.
translations.reference: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.hypothesis: Turkey has also agreed to take back Islamic State fighters it captured whose home countries, it says, are unwilling to take them.

translations.source: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa ba wai kawai wasu dabbobin dinasour suna da gashi ba, wata fadar ma da ta yadu, amma ta yi cikakken bayanin da rubabbun halittu ba za su iya ba, kamar su launi da kuma tsarin kashi uku.
translations.reference: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.hypothesis: This proved that not only did some dinosaurs have feathers, a popular depiction, but it also revealed details that were not possible with fossil records, such as color and patterns.

translations.source: Masana ilimin kimiya sun ce fiffiken dabbar launi kasa ne a sama mai dauke da kodaden launi da launin toka-toka ta karkashin ta.
translations.reference: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists say the rainbow is a multicolored meteorological phenomenon that occurs when sunlight and rain droplets interact.

translations.source: Binciken ya kuma ba da haske game da juyin halittar fukafiki a tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.hypothesis: The study also shed light on the evolution of bird genomes.

translations.source: Domin gashin fuka-fukin dinosaur bashi da isasshen tsari, wanda ake kira kara, amma suna da sauran sifofin gashin fuka-fukan — tsandar gashi da kananan — masu binciken sun kammala cewa wata kila karan wani cigaba ne na juyin halittan wadannan sauran sifofin.
translations.reference: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.hypothesis: Because the dinosaur lung was not very efficient, with a small surface area, but had other bird-like features — hollow bones and feathers — scientists have concluded that the bird was probably an evolutionary offshoot of the dinosaur.

translations.source: Tsarin gashin fuka-fukan ya nuna cewa ba ana amfani da su ba ne domin tashi sama, sai dai domin samar da tsarin daidaiton dumin jiki da kuma motsawa. Binciken ya nuna cewa duk da cewa jelar ta wani karamin kakan kadangare ce, abin na nuna cewa gashin balagagge ne ba na dan tsako ba.
translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The structure of the bones indicates that they were not used for climbing, but for supporting the body and for locomotion. The teeth show that, although the animal was a herbivore, it was not a browser, but a grazer.

translations.source: Masu binciken sun nuna cewa, duk da cewa sun gamsu jelar ta kakannin kadangare ce, ta kuma nuna cewa ta balagagge ce ba jariri ba.
translations.reference: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers said, though they were able to confirm that the fossil was an adult, it was difficult to tell if it was male or female.

translations.source: Jiya da safe a ƙasar Turkiyya, wani bom na cikin mota da aka tayar a hedikwatar ‘yansanda da ke Gaziantep, ya yi sanadiyyar mutuwar jami’an ‘yan sanda biyu tare da raunata wasu mutane sama da ashirin.
translations.reference: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.hypothesis: Yesterday morning in Turkey, a car bomb exploded outside a police station in Gaziantep, killing two officers and injuring more than twenty other people.

translations.source: Ofishin gwamnan ya ce jamia’an yan sanda goma sha tara ne su ka sami raunuka.
translations.reference: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.hypothesis: The governor's office said 19 police officers were injured.

translations.source: Ƴan sanda sun ce suna zargin wani da ake zargin dan ta'addar Daesh (ISIL) ne da alhakin kai harin.
translations.reference: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.hypothesis: Police said they suspected a local ISIL (ISIS) sympathiser was responsible for the attack.

translations.source: Sun gano cewa Rana na aiki akan manufa iri daya kamar sauran taurari: An gano cewa ayukkan duk taurari a cikin tsarin suna samuwa ne ta hasken su, juyin su, banda haka babu komai.
translations.reference: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.hypothesis: They found that the Sun is just another star, and that all stars in the universe are basically the same: they are all balls of gas, and their properties are determined by their mass and their rate of nuclear fusion.

translations.source: Ana amfani da haskawa da juyawa tare domin sanin lambar Rossby ta tauraro, wadda take da alaƙa da gudanar jini.
translations.reference: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.hypothesis: The Rossby number, a measure of the balance between inertial and planetary forces, is used to characterize the flow.

translations.source: Rashin karfin lambar Rossby daidai yake da rashin karfin tauraron tare da magnetic reversal
translations.reference: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.hypothesis: The Rossby wave breaking is associated with the magnetic reconnection event.

translations.source: A lokacin tafiyarsa, Iwasaki ya shiga cikin matsala a lokuta da yawa.
translations.reference: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.hypothesis: During his time there, Iwasaki got into trouble on several occasions.

translations.source: Yan fashin teku sun yi masa fashi, mahaukacin kare ya kai masa farmaki a Tibet, ya guje wa aure a Nepal kuma an kama shi a India.
translations.reference: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.hypothesis: He had been kidnapped by pirates, shanghaied in Tibet, deserted in Nepal and imprisoned in India.

translations.source: Kwatancin 802.11n na aiki duk akan mita 2.4Ghz da 5.0Ghz.
translations.reference: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n operates on both 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz bands.

translations.source: Wannan zai ba shi damar zama mai dacewa da baya 802.11a, 802.11b da 802.11g, matukar dai tashar tushe tana da rediyo biyu.
translations.reference: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.hypothesis: This allows it to be compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, as long as the base station has a dual-band radio.

translations.source: Gudun 802.11n na da saurin da ya zarce na wanda ya gabace shi da tsaikon saurin da ya kai 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: 802.11n is faster than its predecessor with a maximum data rate of 600 Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, wanda ke da mata da manyan yaya guda biyu, bai burge Miller ba, wanda ke da alaƙa da labarin.
translations.reference: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, who has two grown children, is not intimidated by Miller, with whom he is friendly.

translations.source: Da aka nemi tsokacinsa, sai Miller ya ce, “Mike ya yi magana da yawa lokacin zaman jin ba’asin...ina kan shiri saboda haka ban saurari abin da yake cewa ba.”
translations.reference: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.hypothesis: When asked for his reaction, Miller said, "Mike had spoken at length during the break before the vote, and I was prepared for his reaction."

translations.source: “Za mu kokarin rage fitar da gurbataccen carbon dioxide a kowane bangare na GDP ta wani muhimmin mataki a 2020 daga matakin 2005,” in ji Hu.
translations.reference: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.hypothesis: “We will make every effort to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by a significant margin by 2020 from the 2005 level,” Hu said.

translations.source: Bai sanya wani adadi don ragewar ba, inda ya ce hakan zai danganta ne da abin da tattalin arzikin China ke fitarwa.
translations.reference: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.hypothesis: He did not give any figures for the reduction, saying it would depend on how much China's economy grows.

translations.source: Hu ya karfafa kasashe masu tasowa “da su guji tsohuwar hanyar gurbatar da farko da kuma tsabtace ta daga baya.”
translations.reference: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.hypothesis: Hu urged developing countries to “avoid the old path of first polluting and then cleaning up,” and developed countries to “take the lead in reducing emissions and supporting developing countries.”

translations.source: Ya kara da cewa “ kada su yunkura, sai dai kuwa ana sa su daukar nauyi sama da na matakin cigaban su, da kuma daukan alhaki da iyawar su.”
translations.reference: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.hypothesis: He added that they "must not be forced to take on responsibilities beyond their current capacity and capabilities."

translations.source: Kungiyar bincike na Iraq sun gabatar da rohotonsu da karfe 12.00 GMT a yau.
translations.reference: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.hypothesis: The Iraqi inquiry commission is due to present its report at 12.00 GMT today.

translations.source: An yi kashedin cewa babu tabbacin cewa duk wani mataki da za’a dauka a kasar Iraki a yanzu zai iya maganin yakin banbance banbance darika, karuwar rikici ko ma dosar rashin doka da oda.
translations.reference: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.hypothesis: It is unlikely that any action taken in the present circumstances in Iraq will be sufficient to deal with the sectarian, political and security crises that the country is facing.

translations.source: Rahoton ya buɗe ne tare da roƙo don buɗe muhawara da kuma kafa yarjejeniya a Amurka game da manufofin Gabas ta Tsakiya.
translations.reference: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.hypothesis: The report opens with a plea for a new dialogue and a new consensus within the United States about American goals in the Middle East.

translations.source: Rahoton ya yi matuƙar yin suka ga kusan dukkan ɓangarorin manufar Ɓangaren zartaswa na yanzu akan ƙasar Iraƙi inda ya nemi a gaggauta canja alƙibla.
translations.reference: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.hypothesis: The report is highly critical of nearly every aspect of the current administration's policy toward Iraq and calls for a dramatic change in direction.

translations.source: Na farko daga cikin shawarwarin da ta ba su guda 78 shi ne cewa ya kamata a dauki wani sabon shiri na diflomasiyya kafin karshen wannan shekarar don kiyaye iyakokin Iraki kan tsoma bakin da ake yi da kuma sake kulla alakar diflomasiyya da makwabtanta.
translations.reference: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.hypothesis: The first of his 78 recommendations was that a new diplomatic initiative should be launched before the end of the year to secure Iraq's borders against outside interference and to improve relations with its neighbors.

translations.source: Majalisar dattijai da matar shugaban kasar Argentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner ta sanar da fitowar takarar shugaban kasa a yammacin jiya a La Plata, gari dake kilomita 50 (Mil 31) daga Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: The Senate and presidential candidate of the ruling party, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, announced yesterday in La Plata, a city 50 miles (31 km) from Buenos Aires, that she would be running for president.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner ta bayyana ra’niyyarta ta tsayawa takarar shugabanci a Gidan wasannin Argentina, wurin da ta yi amfani da shi domin fara kanfen ɗinta na takarar Majalisar Dattawa a shekarar 2005 a matsayinta na wakiliyar Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.hypothesis: Kirchner announced her presidential bid at a rally in the Argentine city of Mar del Plata, the same city where she launched her 2005 senatorial campaign as a candidate for Buenos Aires province.

translations.hypothesis: Unlike most of the large rivers of the world which are relatively shallow, the Congo River is unusually deep throughout most of its length, and in most places is too deep for navigation by boat," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Branch and Department of Geological Sciences, Northern Arizona University, Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: A Faransa, zaɓe ya kasanace wani abu mai ƙarancin fasahar zamani: masu zaɓe na keɓe kansu a cikin wani akwati, suna saka wata bugaggiyar takarda da ke nuna ɗan takararsu a cikin wata ambulan.

translations.hypothesis: In France, the vote is electronic: voters make their choice on a computer, then print out a paper slip with the candidate's name on it and put it in an envelope.

translations.hypothesis: After confirming the voter's identity with the help of their ID, the pollster marks the ballot paper and hands it to the voter.

translations.source: Dokar zaɓen Faransa ta tsara yadda ake gudanar da zaɓe bisa matuƙar bin ƙa’ida.

translations.source: Tun daga 1988, dole ne akwatunan zabe su kasance ana ganin abin da ke cikinsu domin masu jefa ƙuri'a da masu sa ido su iya shaidar cewa babu wasu ambulan a ciki a farkon kada kuri'un da kuma cewa ba a kara wasu ambulan ba sai dai wadanda aka kidaya kuma daga masu zaɓe da aka tantance.
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1988, ballot boxes have been transparent so that voters and poll watchers can see that they are empty before the start of voting and that no ballots are added except those deposited by eligible voters.

translations.source: Girgizar kasar ta fi kamari ne a tsakanin kilomita 20 (wato mil 15) a arewacin arewa maso gabas da kuma kimanin kilomita 65 (wato mil 40) kudu da Buttle.

translations.source: Nau’in cutar murar tsuntsaye mai hadari ta H5N1, an tabbatar ita ce ta kama agwagwar daji wadda aka samu ranar lahadi a wani surkuki kusa da garin Lyon da ke gabashin Faransa.
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: The H5N1 bird flu virus has been confirmed as the cause of a wild bird found dead on Sunday in a park near Lyon in eastern France.

translations.source: Har yanzu ba’a tabbatar da yawan mutane da ake zargi da kamuwa da H5N1 a Croatia da Denmark.
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.

translations.source: Chambers ta yi karan Ubangiji saboda “yaɗuwar mutuwa ko’ina, halakawa da ta’addanci akan miliyoyin mutanen duniya.”

translations.hypothesis: Chambers prayed for “the spread of death, destruction, and violence” to befall “the millions of people of the world.”

translations.source: Majalisa, wani bafulatani, ya bayar da hujjar cewa karar shi “ba ta da kyau” kuma “kowa na iya tuhumar wani.”
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.hypothesis: The council, a prosecutor, argued that the chargesheet was "vague and ambiguous" and that "anyone could have been charged."

translations.source: Labarin da Camille Saint-Saenstar ya gabatar a wasan dandamali na Faransa,na wani shahararren mai fasaha ne wanda “wanda rayuwarsa ta ta’allaka kan soyayyarsa da kwaya da kasar Japan”
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.hypothesis: The show, presented by Camille Saint-Saëns, is about a famous French artist whose "life was dominated by his passions for love, drugs and Japan."

translations.source: A sakamakon haka, masu wasan kan sha tabar wiwi akan dandamalin wasan, kuma shi kansa gidan wasan yana baiwa masu kallo ƙarfin guiwar yin haka.
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.hypothesis: Consequently, players are encouraged to bet on the gaming platform, and the gaming platform also has the potential to encourage this behaviour.

translations.source: Tsohon kakakin majalisar Newt Gingrich, gwamnan Texas Rick Perry, da uwargidan majalisar wakilai, Michele Bachmann sun gama a mataki na hudu, na biyar, da na shida, bi da bi.
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Former Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich, Texas Governor Rick Perry, and Representative Michele Bachmann came in fourth, fifth, and sixth respectively.

translations.source: Bayan sakamakon ya shigo, Gingrich ya yaba wa Santorum, amma yana da kalmomi masu wuya ga Romney, wanda a madadinsa aka gabatar da tallan kamfe mara kyau a Iowa da Gingrich.
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: After the results came in, Gingrich congratulated Santorum, but had harsh words for Romney, who he said had run a negative campaign in Iowa that backfired.

translations.source: Perry ya fadi cewa zai “dawo Texas domin tantance sakamakon caucus na daren nan, in tantance ko akwai ko akwai alaman ci gaba man a wannan tsere”, amma daga baya ya ce zai ci gaba da tseren sannan ya yi gasan fid da gwani ran 21 ga Janairu a South Carolina.
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: Perry said he would return to Texas to assess the results of Tuesday's caucuses there and determine if there was any point in continuing his pursuit of the nomination, but later said he would press on and compete in the South Carolina primary on January 21.

translations.source: Bachmann, wanda ya lashe zaben Ames Straw Poll a watan Agusta, ya yanke shawarar kawo karshen kamfen din ta.
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.

translations.source: An mayar da mai daukan hoton zuwa asibitin Ronarld Reagan UCLA Medical Center, inda ya mutu.
translations.reference: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.hypothesis: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he later died.

translations.source: An ruwaito cewa yana cikin shekaran sa na 20 ne. A cikin wata sanarwa, Bieber ya ce “duk da ya ke ba na wurin kuma ba ni da hannu kai tsaye cikin wannan mummunan hadarin, tunani da addu'o’ina suna tare da dangin waɗanda abin ya rutsa da su.”
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.hypothesis: He was reportedly in his early 20s. In a statement, Bieber said, "Although I was not in the car, nor under the influence, I feel deeply responsible and am truly sorry for anyone who was hurt or put in danger."

translations.source: Shagin yanar-gizo na labarun nishaɗi na TMZ ya fahimta cewa mai ɗaukar hoto ɗin ya tsayar da motsarsa a tsallaken titin Sepulveda Boulevard kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ɗaukar hotuna na tsayawar ƴan sanda kafin ya tsallaka titin kuma ya ci gaba, wanda ya sa ɗan sanda na Sintirin Babbar Hanya ta California wanda yake ba da hannu ya umarce shi ya koma a ƙetare, sau biyu.
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.hypothesis: The celebrity news website TMZ reported that the photographer had stopped on the shoulder of Sepulveda Boulevard and tried to take pictures of the police activity before driving away, prompting the California Highway Patrol officer who had stopped him to order him to pull over again, twice.

translations.source: Bisa ga fadin yan sanda, direban motan da ya buge mai hoton na iya fuskantan zargin aikata laifi.
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.hypothesis: According to the police, the driver who hit the photographer could be charged with a crime.

translations.source: Da lambobin yabo goma sha takwas kacal da ake da su a rana, kasashe da dama sun gaza kaiwa ga dandamalin bada lambar yabo.
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.hypothesis: With only 18 codes available per day, many countries are missing out on the platform.

translations.source: Sun hada da Netherlands, yayin da Anna Jochemsen ta kammala a ta tara a jerin ajin mata a Super-G jiya, da Finland yayin da Katja ke kammalawa a na goma duk a bikin.
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.hypothesis: They included the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's super-G yesterday, and Finland, with Katja in 10th.

translations.source: Mitchell Gourley na Ostiraliya ya gama na goma sha ɗaya a cikin tsayuwar Super-G na maza. Ɗan gasar Czech Oldrich Jelinek ya gama na goma sha shida a cikin Super-G na zaunen maza.
translations.reference: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished 11th in the men's super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished 16th in the men's super-G.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez na kasar Mexico ya ƙare a matsayin na goma sha biyar a jerin Super-G na maza na zaune. Adam Hall na New Zealand ya ƙare a matsayin na tara a Suƙer-G na maza na tsaye.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mexico's Arly Velasquez finished 15th in the men's standing Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.

translations.source: Mazaje na Poland masu fama da rashin gani a wasan ƙwallon ƙafa Maciej Krezel da jagorar Anna Ogarzynska sun gama na goma sha uku a gasar Super-G. Jong Seork Park na Koriya ta Kudu ya kammala na ashirin da huɗu a gasar maza ta Super-G.

translations.hypothesis: Polish cross-country skiers Maciej Krezel and Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth and fourteenth respectively in the women's Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seok Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's Super-G.

translations.source: Ana tuhumar ma'aikatun majalisar dinkin duniya da suka zo Haiti bayan girgizar kasar shekarar2010 da yada cutuka wayenda suka fara ne daga kusa da mazaunar su.
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.hypothesis: International organizations working in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake have been accused of inadvertently causing a spike in cholera cases that started near their camps.

translations.source: A cewar karar, ba a tsaftace bata daga zangon UN kamar yadda ya kamata ba, ya haddasa kwayoyin cuta shigan ruwa wadda yake kwarara cikin Rafin Artibonite, daya daga ciki babba a Haiti.
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: The case alleges that the waste was improperly stored at a UN base, causing a spill that contaminated the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's main waterways.

translations.source: Kafin isowar sojoji, Haiti bata taba fuskantar matsalolin da suka shafi cutar ba tun a shekarun 1800s.
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Before the military intervention, Haiti had faced no such sustained outbreaks since the early 1800s.

translations.source: Cibiyar Tabbatar da Adalci da Demokradiyya ta ƙasar Haiti ta nakalto waɗansu ayyukan nazari masu zaman kansu waɗanda ke tsammanin bataliyar kiyaye zaman lafiya ta Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya da ke Nepal ce ta kawo cutar Haiti bisa rashin sani.
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: Haiti's Center for the Prevention and Management of Disasters blamed the United Nations peacekeeping mission in Nepal for bringing cholera to Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, ƙwararriyar masaniyar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya kan cutar, ta bayyana cewa mai yiyuwa ne sojojin kiyaye zaman lafiya suka haifar da cutar.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, a senior epidemiologist with the World Health Organization, said it was possible the peacekeeping forces had introduced the disease.

translations.source: Hamilton ya tabbatar da Asibitin Jami'ar Howard ya ba da haƙuri a cikin kwanciyar hankali.
translations.reference: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton confirmed that Howard University Hospital is safe.

translations.source: Marar lafiyar ya je Najeriya, inda aka samu wasu sun kamu da cutar ta Ebola.
translations.reference: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.hypothesis: The patient had travelled to Nigeria, where there have been some cases of Ebola.

translations.source: Asibitin ta bi ka’idoji na kula da kamuwa da cuta, tare da raba masu jiyya daga sauran jama’a domin hana yaduwan cutan.
translations.reference: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.hypothesis: The hospital follows standard infection prevention and control protocols, including isolating patients with suspected or confirmed mpox from other patients and the general public.

translations.source: Kafin Simpsons Simon ya yi aiki a kan shirye-shirye da yawa a wurare daban-daban.
translations.reference: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.hypothesis: Before The Simpsons, Simon worked on a number of shows in various capacities.

translations.source: A lokacin 1980s yayi aiki a kan shirye-shirye kamar Taxi, Cheers, da The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.hypothesis: In the 1980s he had roles in shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracey Ullman Show.

translations.source: A cikin 1989 ya taimaka ƙirƙirar Simpsons tare da Brooks da Groening, kuma shi ke da alhakin ɗaukar ƙungiyar masu rubutu na farko.
translations.reference: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.hypothesis: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and he was responsible for hiring the show's first writers.

translations.source: Duk da barin wasan shirin a 1993 an cigaba da kiransa shugaban shiri, kuma ya cigaba da karbar miliyoyin daloli a kowace kaka na kamasho.
translations.reference: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.hypothesis: Although he left the show in 1993 he continued to be referred to as the show's host and continued to make millions of dollars a year.

translations.source: Tun farko kamfanin dillacin labarai na China Xinhua ya ba da rahoton wani jirgin da aka sace.
translations.reference: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua initially reported a kidnapping.

translations.source: Rahotanni daga baya sun nuna cewa an yi wa jirgin barazanar harin bam, sannan aka karkatar da shi zuwa Afghanistan, inda ya sauka a Kandahar.

translations.hypothesis: Reports afterwards showed the plane had been hijacked and rerouted to Afghanistan, where it landed in Kandahar.

translations.source: Rahotannin farko sun ce an juya akalar jirgin zuwa Afghanistan bayan an hana shi saukar gaggawa a Ürümqi.

translations.hypothesis: Initial reports suggested the aircraft had been heading to Afghanistan after being denied permission to land in Urumqi.

translations.source: Hadarin jirgin sama ya zama ruwan dare a Iran, sakamakon tsoffin jirage wadanda ba a kula da su na ayyukan farar hula da sojoji.
translations.reference: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.hypothesis: Air crashes are a regular occurance in Iran, due to the aging and poorly maintained civil and military aircraft.

translations.source: Takunkumin ƙasa da ƙasa na nufin ba za a iya sayan sabon jirgin sama ba.

translations.hypothesis: International aid covers only a small portion of the new aircraft purchases.

translations.reference: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crashed, killing three people and injuring two others.

translations.reference: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.hypothesis: Last month, Iran was the scene of the deadliest plane crash in its history, when a jet en route to Armenia went down, killing all 168 people on board.

translations.source: A dai wannan watan ne wani jirgin saman ya kauce daga kan titin da jirgi yake tafiya a kai kafin tsahinsa a Mashad inda ya bugi wata katanga, tare da kashe mutum sha bakwai.
translations.reference: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier this month, a bus carrying a wedding party overturned on a highway near Mashhad, killing 17 people.

translations.source: Aerosmith sun soke sauran kade-kade a yawon shakatawansu.
translations.reference: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith have canceled the rest of their tour.

translations.source: Ƙungiyar makaɗan rock za ta fara yawon kaɗe-kaɗe a Amurka da Canada har zuwa 16 ga Satumba.
translations.reference: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.hypothesis: The band will kick off their North American leg of the tour on September 16th.

translations.source: Sun soke yawon shakatawa bayan fitaccen mawaƙi Steven Tyler ya ji rauni bayan ya faɗo daga fage yayin wasan a ranar 5 ga watan Agusta.

translations.source: Potro ya sami kulawa a kafadarsa a wannan lokacin amma ya sami nasarar komawa wasan.
translations.reference: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.hypothesis: Potro had suffered a broken leg earlier in the season but had managed to return to action.

translations.source: An fara shirin da karfe 8:30 na yamma (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: The event will start at 18:30 CET (15:00 UTC).

translations.hypothesis: Then, Lakkha Singh led the singing of the bhajan.

translations.source: A lokacin gabatar da babban bayani na ranar Alhamis a Nunin Wasan Tokyo, shugaban Nintendo Satoru Iwata ya kaddamar da tsarin sarrafawa na sabuwar na’urar Nintendo Re volution.
translations.reference: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.hypothesis: At a press conference on Thursday in Tokyo, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the Wii U, Nintendo's next home console.

translations.source: Kamar makunnin talabijin, makunnin abun yana amfani da sanser biyu da aka jona kusa da talabijin din don a iya gane inta take.
translations.reference: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.

translations.source: Wannan zai bai wa masu wasannin bidiyo damar sarrafa wasan ta hanyar motsi da na’urar a cikin iska.
translations.reference: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.hypothesis: This allows players to control the game using motion and gestures in the air.

translations.source: Motar Giancarlo Fisichella ta kwace masa inda hakan ya jawo fitarsa daga tseren jim kaɗan bayan farawa.
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella's car broke down on the first lap, ending his race early.

translations.source: Abokin wasansa Fernando Alonso shi ne kan gaba a mafi wasane, amma ya tsaya bayan dakatawar zango, watakila saboda lanƙwashewar wilin tayar gaba na ɓangaren dama ne.

translations.hypothesis: Teammate Fernando Alonso is the only other driver on the grid who has won a race, but he is unlikely to challenge for the title given his team's lack of development.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ya gama tserensa ba da daɗewa ba bayan Alonso, saboda lalacewar dakatarwa a yaƙe-yaƙe da yawa yayin tseren.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher finished a distant second after an early pit stop due to damage sustained in the first lap melee.

translations.source: “Tana da kyau sannan tana waka da kyau, kuma,” ya bayana bisa ga kwafi na taron masu yada labaru.
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.hypothesis: "She's fun and she's a good singer, too," he said in a statement to reporters.

translations.source: “An motsa ni kowane lokacin da muke yin maimaitawa kan wannan, daga cikin zuciya ta.”
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.hypothesis: "I was thrilled each time we did this, from the bottom of my heart."

translations.source: Kimanin mintuna 3 da harba jirgin, na’urara daukan hoton da ke ciki ta nuna yadda wani soson kariya ya balle daga jikin tankin mai.
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.hypothesis: About 3 minutes after liftoff, an external camera showed a protective panel falling off the fuel tank.

translations.source: Duk da haka, ba'a tunanin cewa sun haifar da wata ɓarna ga abin sufurin.
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.hypothesis: However, it is unlikely that they will cause any significant damage to the vehicle.

translations.source: Babban jami'in shirin rufe jirgin NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr. ya ce kumburin ya fadi “bayan lokacin da muke damuwa.”
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.hypothesis: The NASA space shuttle program manager, N. Wayne Hale Jr., said the damage was "beyond what we would consider acceptable".

translations.source: Mintuna biyar da fara nunin wata iska ya fara shigowa ciki, kusan minti daya daga baya, iskar ta doshi 70km/h... daga baya ruwan sama yazo, amma da yawa da ƙarfinsa ya sauko yadda zai bugi fatarka kamar allura, saannan wani kankara ya fado daga sama, mutane suna firgita suna kururuwa suna tattake juna.
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.hypothesis: Five minutes into the show, the wind started picking up, and a minute later, it was 70 km/h... then the rain came, and with it, the wind's intensity dropped to the point where it stung your skin like needles, and then the hail started, and people started screaming and running and huddling together.

translations.source: Na rasa yar uwata tare da kawarta, kuma a hanya na gamu da wasu nakasassu biyu a kan keke, jama’a suna ta tsallake su tare da tura su,” inji Armand Versace.
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.hypothesis: I lost my sister and her friend, and on the way to the hospital, I saw two people who had died on the street, people were just stepping over them,” said Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK ta kuma ruwaito cewa masana’antar samar da makamashin nukiliya ta Kashiwazaki Kariwa a gundumar Niigata tana aiki yadda yakamata.
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.hypothesis: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata Prefecture was operating normally.

translations.source: Kamfanin Hokuriku Electric Power Co. ya ba da rahoton babu wata illa daga girgizar kasar kuma an rufe matatar mai lamba 1 da 2 a tashar makamashin nukiliyar ta Shika.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no problems from the earthquake and that reactors 1 and 2 at the Shika nuclear power plant were automatically shut down.

translations.source: An ba da rohoto cewa gidaje 9400 a yankin ba su da ruwa sannan kusan 100 ba su da lantarki.
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.hypothesis: Reportedly, 9400 homes in the region do not have access to water and nearly 100 do not have electricity.

translations.source: Wasu hanyoyi sun lalace, al'amuran jirgin kasa ya katse a wuraren da abin ya shafa, kuma Filin jirgin saman Noto da ke yankin Ishikawa ya kasance a rufe.
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.hypothesis: Some roads were impassable, rail services were suspended in the affected areas, and Komatsu Airport in Ishikawa Prefecture was closed.

translations.source: Wani bam ɗaya ya fashe a wajen ofishin gwamna-janar.
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.hypothesis: One bomb exploded outside the governor-general's office.

translations.source: Karin Bama-bamai uku sun fashe kusa a gine-ginen gwamnati a cikin tsawon sa’aoi biyu.
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.hypothesis: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings within two hours.

translations.source: Wasu rahotanni sun kai adadin mutuwan zuwa takwas, kuma tabbatacciyar rahoto na tabbatar da cewa mutum 30 suka ji rauni; amma ba a san adadin ƙarshe ba.
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.hypothesis: Some reports put the death toll at eight, and a confirmed report says that 30 people were injured; but the final tally is not yet known.

translations.source: Dukkanin cyanuric acid da melamine an same su ne a cikin kayan fitsari daga dabbobin gidan da suka mutu bayan sun sha gurbataccen abincin dabbobi.
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.hypothesis: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were detected in kidneys of pigs that had been fed the contaminated feed.

translations.source: Magungunan biyu suna aiki tare da juna don samar da lu'ulu'u wanda zai iya toshe aikin koda, masu bincike a jami'ar sun ce.
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.hypothesis: The two medicines work together to produce pearls that can block the tubes, according to researchers at the university.

translations.source: Masu binciken sun lura cewa kiristal sun taru a fisarin kyanwa ta hanyar karin sinadarin melanin da cyanuric.
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers have found that the crystals form in the outer layer of the cornea by combining with melanin and cyanuric acid.

translations.source: Jumlar sanfurin gilashin suna kama da wanda aka samu a fitsarin dabbar yayin da aka kafa a na’urar infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: The sum of the vibrational modes of the molecules gives rise to the absorption spectrum which is unique to each compound and can be recorded with a Fourier Transform Infrared Spectrometer (FTIR).

translations.source: Ban sani ba ko kun gane shi ko a'a, amma yawancin kayayyaki daga Amurka ta Tsakiya sun shigo wannan ƙasa ba tare da biyan haraji ba.
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.hypothesis: I don't know if you get it or not, but most of the products from Central America that come into this country come in duty-free.

translations.source: Duk da haka kashi tamanin cikin kayan mu sun samu haraji a kasashen Amurka ta tsakiya. Zamu kula da kai.
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: However, 80% of our packages are delivered successfully across Central America. We will handle it.

translations.source: Na kasa fahimtar abin, hakika babu adalci a ciki.
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: I couldn't make sense of it, it was just unfair.

translations.source: Kawai abin da na ke ce wa mutane shine ku bi da mu yadda muke bi da ku.
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: All I would say is follow where we are going.

translations.source: Gwamnan California Arnold Schwarzenegger ya sanya hannu a cikin wata doka da ta hana sayarwa ko hayar wasannin bidiyo mai tashin hankali ga ƙananan yara.
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed a law that makes it illegal to sell or rent violent video games to minors.

translations.source: Dokar na bukatar a sanya wa wasannin bidiyo na tashin hankali da ake sayarwa a jihar California alama da ke nuna “18” inda ya zamo sayar da su ga kananan yara laifi ne mai jawo hukuncin tarar $1000 a kowane laifi.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The law requires that video games with violent content be labeled with a "Mature 17+" rating in California, and selling them to minors would result in a $1,000 fine per offense.

translations.source: Darektan gabatar da kara na hukumar, Kier Starmer QC, a safiyar yau ya sanar da gurfanar da mutanen biyu, Huhne da Pryce, a gaban shari’a.
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: The Labour leader, Keir Starmer QC, announced earlier today that two people, Huhne and Price, had been charged with perverting the course of justice.

translations.source: Huhne ya yi murabus kuma za a maye gurbinsa a Majalisar da Dan Majalisa Ed Davey. Ana tsammanin Dan Majalisa Norman Lamb zai zama Ministan Kasuwanci aikin da Job Davey zai ajiye.
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne has resigned and will be replaced in the cabinet by Lib Dem peer Lord Davies. Norman Lamb is expected to be named as the new Business Secretary to replace David Jones.

translations.source: Huhne da Pryce an shirya za su bayyana a Kotun Majistare ta Westminster a ranar 16 ga Fabrairu.
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne and Price are due to appear at Westminster Magistrates' Court on 16 February.

translations.source: Wandanda suka rasu sun hada da Nicholas Alden dan shekara 25, da Zachary Cuddeback mai shekara 21. Cuddeback ya kasance mai tukin.
translations.reference: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.hypothesis: The deceased included 25-year-old Nicholas Alden and 21-year-old Zachary Cuddeback. Cuddeback was the driver.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla ya sami raunuka a hannusa da muƙamuƙi yayin da aka bar Kristoffer Schneider yana buƙatar tiyata ta gyaran fuskar sa.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla sustained a broken nose and several facial lacerations while Kristoffer Schneider required surgery to repair his face.

translations.source: Makamin Uka ya kasa yayin da yake auna kan mutum na biyar. Schneider na da raɗaɗi da ke gudana, makanta a ido daya, wani bangaren ƙoƙon kai da ya ɓata da fuska da aka sake ginawa daga titanium.
translations.reference: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.hypothesis: The rifle jammed after the fifth shot. Schneider had a broken nose, a split lip, a missing front tooth and a face reconstructed with titanium plates.

translations.source: Schneider ya ba da shaida ta wurin video link daga tashar USAF a kasarsa na haihuwa.
translations.reference: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider gave testimony via video link from his hometown's USAF base.

translations.source: Bayan abubuwan da suka faru a ranar Laraba, Carpanedo ya yi gasa a tsere guda biyu a wasannin neman zakara.
translations.reference: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.hypothesis: After Wednesday's events, Carpanedo competed in two more matches in the championship tournament.

translations.source: Na farko ita ce Slalom, inda ta samu nasarar Ba ta inarshe ba a wasanninta na farko. 36 daga cikin gasa 116 sun sami irin wannan sakamakon a wannan tseren.
translations.reference: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.hypothesis: The first was Slalom, where he didn't make it out of the first round. 36 of the 116 competitors in this race had the same result.

translations.source: Sauran tseren nata, Giant Slalom, ta ga ta gama a matsayi na goma a rukunin mata tare da saurin gudu na 4: 41.30, 2: 11.60 a hankali fiye da na farkon da ta kammala mai Austrian Claudia Loesch da minti 1: 09.02 a hankali fiye da na tara. Gyöngyi Dani na Hungary.
translations.reference: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.hypothesis: In the other race she entered, the Giant Slalom, she placed tenth in the women's group with a time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 off the winner, Austrian Claudia Loesch, and 1:09.02 off ninth place, Hungary's Gyöngyi Dani.

translations.source: Hudu daga cikin masu tsere a kungiyar mata sun gaza kamala gudu, kuma 45 a cikin 117 masu tsere a Giant Slalom sun kasa samun nasara a tseren.
translations.reference: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.hypothesis: Four of the team's skiers failed to finish the run, and 45 of the 117 starters failed to complete the course.

translations.source: ‘Yan sandan Madhya Pradesh sun karbo laptop da wayar hannu da aka sace.
translations.reference: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.hypothesis: Madhya Pradesh police recover stolen laptops, phones

translations.source: D K Arya, mataimakin Sufeto Janar ya ce, “Mun kama mutane biyar da suka yi wa yar kasar Switzerland fyade kuma an gano wayarta ta hannu da kwamfutar taa
translations.reference: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.hypothesis: "Five people have been arrested in connection with the attack on the Swiss national and his laptop was also recovered," said D K Arya, Deputy Superintendent of Police.

translations.source: Wadanda ake zargin sun hada da Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar da Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: The accused are Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaja Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Sufiritendan ‘yan sanda Chandra Shekhar Solanki ya ce wanda ake zargin ya gurfana gaban kotu - fuska rufe.
translations.reference: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.hypothesis: Police spokesperson Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused was produced before a magistrate and sent to jail.

translations.source: Kodayake mutane uku ke ciki lokacin da motar ta yi karo da gidan, amma ba wanda da ya ji rauni a cikinsu.
translations.reference: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.hypothesis: Although three people were in the car when it crashed into the house, none of them were hurt.

translations.source: Koyaya, direban yana ɗaukar munanan raunuka a kan sa.
translations.reference: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.hypothesis: The driver, however, sustained serious injuries.

translations.source: Titin da akayi hatsarin yana rufe na dan wani lokaci yayin da musa aikin gaggawa  suke ceto mutumin daga cikin jar Audi TT.
translations.reference: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.hypothesis: The car had been on its side for some time when emergency services arrived and extracted the man from the Audi TT.

translations.source: Da farko an kwantar da shi a asibitin James Paget da ke Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: He was first admitted to James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: Daga baya aka canja masa wurin zuwa Asibitin Addenbrooke wanda yake Cambridge.
translations.reference: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: He was later transferred to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.

translations.source: Tuni Adekoya ke Kotun Edinburgh in da a ke tuhumarta da kashe danta.
translations.reference: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.hypothesis: Tuni Adekoya is on trial in Edinburgh for the murder of her son.

translations.source: Tana tsare kafin shigar da kara da kuma hukunci, amma ko wani shaidar wanda ya agni da ido zai iya zama gurbatacce saboda yadda aka yada hoton ta.
translations.reference: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.hypothesis: It is preserved before the trial and conviction, but any evidence that is collected can be manipulated because of the nature of the media.

translations.source: Wannan shi ne abin gama gari a wasu wurare a cikin Ingila amma adalci na Scottish yana aiki daban kuma kotunan suna kallon wallafa hotunan a matsayin mai yuwuwar wariya.
translations.reference: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.hypothesis: This is more common in England than in Scotland, where the law is slightly different and police forces are unlikely to consider posting photos of you online as harassment.

translations.source: Farfesa Pamela Ferguson na Jami'ar Dundee ta lura “ƴan jarida na ganin kamar suna tafiya ne a wani layi mai hadari idan wallafa hotuna da sauransu wadanda ake zargi.”
translations.reference: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.hypothesis: Professor Pamela Ferguson of Dundee University commented that "the press appear to be skating on very thin ice when they publish photographs and other material which purports to show the victims".

translations.source: Ofishin gabatar da Ƙararraki, wanda ke da alhakin gabatar da tuhuma, ya bayyana wa ‘yan jarida cewa ba shi da wani bayani da zai kara har sai bayan an karbi shigar da karar.
translations.reference: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.hypothesis: The State Prosecution Office, responsible for bringing charges, said in a statement to the press that it would not comment on the specifics of the case until after the charges have been filed.

translations.source: Takardar, gwargwadon fallasar, za ta yi magana ne kan rikicin iyakoki, wanda Falasɗinawa ke son ya ɗora shi kan iyakokin kafin Yaƙin Gabas ta Tsakiya na 1967.
translations.reference: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.hypothesis: The resolution, which is non-binding, addresses the issue of the border, which Palestinians want to align with the pre-1967 borders.

translations.source: Sauran batu da aka tattauna bisa ga fadi sun hada da Jerusalem a nan gaba wadda ke da tsarki ga al’umma biyun tare da batun Jordan Valley.
translations.reference: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.hypothesis: Other pending issues that were raised during the discussions included Jerusalem with its holy places for the two religions and the issue of the Jordan Valley.

translations.source: Isra'ila ta bukaci sojoji su ci gaba da kasancewa a kwarin na tsawon shekaru goma matukar an rattaba hannu yayin da hukumar falasdinawa ta amince da barin irin wannan kasancewar na tsawon shekaru biyar kacal.
translations.reference: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.hypothesis: Israel demanded a ten-year military presence in the Sinai Peninsula in exchange for signing the treaty, while the Palestinians only agreed to a five-year term.

translations.source: Maharba masu aikin gwajin maganin kwari, zasu kasance karkashin kulawar malaman gandun daji, yayin gwajin domin tantance ingancinsa.
translations.reference: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.hypothesis: Volunteers in the polio surveillance programme, who work under the supervision of the Ministry of Health, will continue to carry out their essential duties.

translations.source: A cikin haɗin gwiwar NPWS da Sportungiyar Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, an ɗauki ƙwararrun masu sa kai, a ƙarƙashin shirin wasannin kungiyar maharba.
translations.reference: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.hypothesis: In association with the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, professional coaching is available through the club, under the guidance of accredited coaches.

translations.source: A cewar Mick O'Flynn, na'ibin Daraktan na Park Conservation da Heritage tare da NPWS, maharban guda hudu da aka zaba don aikin harbi na farko sun sami cikakken tsaro da horo.
translations.reference: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.hypothesis: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Director of National Parks & Wildlife Service (NPWS), the four rangers selected for the trial have received extensive safety and tactical training.

translations.source: Martelly ya rantsar da sabuwar Kwamitin Zabe na Wucin-gadi (CEP) mai membobi guda tara.
translations.reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly swore in the nine-member Provisional Electoral Council (CEP).

translations.source: Shi ne CEP Matelly na biyar cikin shekara hudu.
translations.reference: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.hypothesis: This is Matelly's fifth CEP in four years.

translations.source: A watan da ya gabata ne wani kwamiti na shugaban kasa ya ba da shawarar murabus din CEP tun gabani a matsayin bangare na kunshin daukar matakan ciyar da kasar gaba zuwa sabon zabe.
translations.reference: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.hypothesis: Last month, a presidential commission recommended the immediate suspension of the CEP as part of a package of measures to move the country forward toward new elections.

translations.source: Kwamitin ya kasance martanin Martelly ne game da yaɗuwar zanga-zangar adawa da tsarin mulki da aka fara a watan Oktoba.
translations.reference: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.hypothesis: The committee was Martelly's response to weeks of anti-government protests that began in October.

translations.source: Zanga-zangar da wani lokaci suke da tashin hankali sun faru ne saboda gaza yin zaɓuɓɓuka, waɗansu lokacinsu ya wuce tun 2011.
translations.reference: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.hypothesis: The protests, which have at times turned violent, have been called for in response to the perceived failure of the political class to address the country's many problems, some of which date back to the aftermath of the 2011 revolution.

translations.source: An ba da rohoton iPods da ba sa aiki kusan 60 saboda yawan ɗaukar zafi, wannan ya haddasa gobara har guda shida tare da barin mutane hudu da kananan ƙuna.
translations.reference: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
