translations.hypothesis: About 60 defective iPods were reportedly responsible for the fire, which caused six injuries and left four people with minor burns.

translations.source: Ma’aikatar tattalin arziki, Ciniki da Masana’antu ta Japan (METI) ta ce tana sane da hatsarurruka guda 27 da ke da alaƙa da na’urorin.
translations.reference: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.hypothesis: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) says it is aware of 27 risks associated with the technology.

translations.source: A makon da ya gabata, METI ta sanar da cewa Apple ya sanar da shi wasu karin lamura masu zafi fiye da 34, wadanda kamfanin ya kira “marasa mahimmanci.”
translations.reference: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.hypothesis: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional hotfix releases, which the company deemed "unimportant."

translations.source: Kungiyar tsaron ta bada martani da kiran daga bayanin na Appe "abun bakin-ciki"
translations.reference: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.hypothesis: The security firm responded to Apple's claims, calling them "misleading."

translations.source: Girgizan kasa ta bugi Mariana da karfe 07:19 na safe (09:19 p.m. GMT Juma’a).
translations.reference: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: The earthquake struck at 7:19 a.m. local time (0919 GMT Friday).

translations.source: Ofishin gudanarwar da aikin gaggawa na Northern Marianas ya ce babu rohoton barna da aka samu a ƙasar.
translations.reference: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.hypothesis: The Northern Mariana Islands' emergency management office said there were no reports of damage on the islands.

translations.source: Haka kuma Cibiyar Fitar da Gargaɗi kan Tsunami ta yankin Pacific ta sanar da cewa babu alamar Tsunami.
translations.reference: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.hypothesis: The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center also reported no tsunami threat.

translations.source: Wani tsohon dan sanda na Philippines ya tsare mutanen da ke yawon bude ido a Hong Kong ta hanyar satar motar bas din su a Manila, babban birnin Philippines.
translations.reference: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: A former Philippine police officer has been arrested in Hong Kong for allegedly stealing a busload of tourists in Manila, the Philippines' capital.

translations.source: Ronaldo Mendoza ya harba bindigarsa samfurin M16 akan ‘yan yawon shaƙatawar.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Ronaldo Mendoza opened fire on the tourists with his M16 rifle.

translations.source: An ceto da dama cikin wadanda aka yi garkuwa da su din, yayin da aka tabbatar da mutuwar akalla guda shida daga cikinsu ya zuwa yanzu.
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.hypothesis: Some of the hostages have been released, while at least six deaths have been confirmed so far.

translations.source: An saki mutane shida da aka yi garkuwa da su, ciki har da yara da tsofaffi da wuri, da kuma masu daukar hoto na Philippines.
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.hypothesis: Six hostages, including children and elderly people, and a Filipino photojournalist have been released.

translations.source: Masu daukar hoto daga baya sun maye gurbin wata tsohuwa saboda tana bukatar dakin wankan. An bindige Mendoza.
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.hypothesis: The cameraman was later replaced by an older man because he needed to use the bathroom. Mendoza was arrested.

translations.source: Liggins yabi sahun baban shi ya zabi aikin likitanci.
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins followed in his father's footsteps and chose to become a doctor.

translations.source: Ya sami horo a matsayin likitan fannin haihuwa kuma ya fara aiki a Asibitin Mata na Ƙasa da ke Auckland a shekarar 1959.
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.hypothesis: He trained as an obstetrician and started work at Auckland Hospital in 1959.

translations.source: A yayin da yake aiki a asibitin, liggins ya fara bincike akan yin nakuda da wurin a lokacin da baya aiki.
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.hypothesis: During his time at the hospital, Leggins began researching disability and inclusion in the workplace.

translations.source: Bincikensa ya nuna cewa idan an yi amfani da maganin hormone zai hanzarta nuna kosawar huhun jaririn.
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.hypothesis: His research has shown that inhaled nitric oxide can safely and quickly improve oxygen levels in premature babies.

translations.source: Xinhua ya bayar da rahoton cewa masu binciken gwamnati sun gano na’urorin naɗar sauti biyu na 'bakin akwatin’ ranar Laraba.
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua reported that government investigators found two audio recording devices on Wednesday.

translations.source: Abokan kokawar Luna sun yi jimamin mutuwar ta.
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Luna's competitors have a higher death rate.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer yace "Luna ta kasance Sarauniyar Tsaurarawa. manaja ta ta farko. Luna ta mutu ne a daren wata guda biyu. Abu na musamman kamar ita. mace mai jajircewa."
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer said, "Luna was the Queen of Hardcore. The first lady of ECW. Luna passed away two weeks ago. There was no one like her. She was a true survivor."

translations.source: Dustin “Goldust” Runnels ta yi sharhi cewa “Luna ta kasance mai rauni sosai kamar ni ... wataƙila ma fiye da haka ... ƙaunace ta zai batar da ita ... da fatan tana cikin wuri mafi kyau.”
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented, "Luna was as fragile as I was...maybe even more so...her innocence would be destroyed by this...I pray she is in a better place."

translations.source: Daga cikin mutane 1,400 da aka jefa kuri’a gabanin zaben tarayya na 2010, wadanda ke adawa da Australia ta zama jamhuriya sun karu da kashi 8 cikin 100 tun daga shekarar 2008.
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Of the 1,400 people surveyed before the 2010 federal election, 8 per cent supported Australia becoming a republic, up from 5 per cent in 2008.

translations.source: Minista mai rikon kwarya Julia Gillard ta yi ikirarin a lokacin yakin neman zaben shekarar 2010 cewa ya yi imani Australia za ta zama jamhuriya a karshen mulkin Sarauniya Elizabeth II.
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: Acting Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the 2010 election campaign that he had said Australia would become a republic after the Queen's death.

translations.source: kashi 34 na wadanda ke cikin jin ra’ayoyin suna da ra’ayi kamar wannan, son Sarauniya Elizabeth II ta zama mai sarauta ta karshe a Australia.
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: 34% of respondents had the opinion that the Queen should be the last Governor-General in Australia.

translations.source: Jin ra’ayoyin jama’a ya nuna cewa kaso 29 na mutanen Australiya na goyon bayan zamanta jamhuriyya cikin gaggawa yayin da kaso 31 kuma ke sukar ra’ayin ta zama jamhuriya.
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: Public opinion polls show that 29% of Australians support a republic immediately while 31% would prefer to retain the monarchy.

translations.source: Wanda ya lashe lambar zinare a gasar Olympics ya kamata ne ya yi iyo a tseren mita 100 da 200 kuma a cikin wasanni uku a wasannin Commonwealth, amma saboda korafin da ya yi ya nuna shakku kan lafiyar sa.
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.hypothesis: The Olympic gold medallist was due to run in the 100m and 200m at the three-day event, but his withdrawal raises questions about his fitness.

translations.source: Ya gaza shan magungunan da ake bukata domin shawo kan raɗaɗin da yake ji saboda an haramtawa amfani da su a Wasannin.
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.hypothesis: He was unable to take the medication required to treat his depression because it was prohibited by the Games.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, masanin lissafi kuma farfesan kimiyyar kwamfuta a Jami'ar Missouri ta Tsakiya, ya gano lamba mafi girman da wata bata shiga cikinta da aka sani a ranar 25 ga watan Janairu.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer scientist at the University of Central Missouri, found the largest known prime number on January 25.

translations.source: Mutane da yawa sun tantance abin da aka gano ta amfani da sassa da kwakwalwar na’ura daban-daban a farkon Fabrairu kuma an ba da sanarwar ranar Talata.
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.hypothesis: The find was confirmed using several instruments and telescopes in early February and announced on Tuesday.

translations.source: Mai yiwuwa taurari masu wutsiya sun kasance ta cikinsu ruwan sama ke zuwa duniya tare da takin dabbobi wanda ke iya samar da kayan gina jiki domin tallafar rayuwa.
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.hypothesis: It is possible that icy comets delivered water and organic molecules to the early Earth, providing the building blocks for life.

translations.source: Masana kimiyya suna fatan fahimtar yadda taurari suke samuwa, musamman yadda Duniya ta samu, tunda taurari masu wutsiya suka yi karo da duniya lokaci mai tsawo da ya gabata.
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists hope to learn more about how stars are born, including how our own solar system came into being, since the sun is a fairly ordinary star.

translations.source: Cuomo, mai shekaru 53, ya fara mulkin sa a farkon wannan shekarar kuma ya sanya hannu kan wata doka a watan da ya halatta auren jinsi.
translations.reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.hypothesis: 53-year-old Cuomo, who just started his term earlier this year, signed the bill into law in June of this year.

translations.source: Ya kira jita-jitar da cewa “hirar siyasa da wauta”.
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.hypothesis: He called the rumours "political propaganda."

translations.source: Ana hasashen zai tsaya takarar shugaban kasa a 2016.
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.hypothesis: He was expected to run for president in 2016.

translations.source: NextGen tsari ne wanda FAA ke ikirarin zai bawa jirgin sama damar yin gajeren hanyoyi da kuma adana miliyoyin galan na mai a kowace shekara da kuma yanke hayakin mai.
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen is a program by the FAA that claims to allow aircraft to fly more direct routes and save millions of gallons of fuel and cut emissions.

translations.source: Yana amfani da fasahar tauraron dan adam maimakon amfani da rada a doron kasa domin baiwa masu kula da zirga zirgar jiragen sama damar gane inda jirage su ke babu kuskure ta yadda za su iya baiwa matukan jirgin sama cikakkun bayanai.
translations.reference: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.hypothesis: It uses a satellite-based technology that replaces the need for ground-based radar to allow air traffic controllers to see the exact location of aircraft and provide pilots with accurate information.

translations.source: Ba a kara ababen hawa ba, sannan jirgin kasa da ba na karkashin kasa ba, ba zai tsaya a wimbledon ba, sannan babu wajen ajiye motoci da na hawan motoci a wurin.
translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.hypothesis: No vehicles can be parked on the grounds, and the tube station at Wimbledon is not on the Underground, but on a branch line with limited parking.

translations.source: Tsoron rashin isassun motocin zirga zirga na iya tilasta a yi wasan ba tare da yan kallo sun halarta ba.
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.hypothesis: The fear of running out of petrol may necessitate matches being played without fans.

translations.source: Wani bincike da aka wallafa ranar Alhamis a mujallar Science ya ba da rohoto kan samuwar wani sabon jintsin tsuntsaye a Tsibiran Galapagos na Ecuadoria.
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.hypothesis: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reports the discovery of a new species of finch on the Galapagos Islands of Ecuador.

translations.source: Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Princeton da ke Amurka da kuma Jami'ar Uppsala da ke Sweden sun ba da rahoton cewa sabon jinsin ya samo asali ne a tsararraki biyu kawai, duk da cewa an yi imani da cewa wannan aikin zai dauki lokaci mai tsawo, saboda yaduwar da ke tsakanin tsaunin Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, da kuma bakin kakakus. finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden report that the new species is only found on two islands, despite the fact that this is believed to be a relatively recent evolutionary event, based on the large genetic distance between Darwin's finches, Geospiza fortis, and the cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.

translations.source: Ana iya aikata zinare zuwa kowane irin fasali. Za'a iya mulmula shi zuwa ƙananan abubuwa.
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.hypothesis: Gold can be applied to any feature. It can be applied to micro-transactions.

translations.source: Ana iya tale shi ya zama siririyar waya, wadda ake iya nadewa ko a kulle, Kuma ana iya dunkule ta ko nada ta zuwa falle falle.
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.hypothesis: It can be made as a simple string, which can be tied or locked, or it can be made more complicated with bells and whistles.

translations.source: Ana iya yin sa ya zama siriri sosai, kuma ya makale jikin wani ƙarfen. Ana iya yin sa ya zama siriri sosai har wani lokacin ana amfani dashi don yin ado ga hotuna da aka zana da hannu a cikin littattafan da ake kira “illuminated manuscripts”.
translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: It can be very ornate, and applied to the borders of a page. It can be highly stylized and sometimes used decoratively in illuminated manuscripts.

translations.source: Ana kiran wannan Chemical pH. Za ka iya saka alama ta amfani da ruwan jan kabeji.
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.hypothesis: This is called the chemical pH. You can test this with litmus paper.

translations.source: Lemun kabeji na canza launin bisa yanayin yawan acid ko alkaline din ma’adanin.
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.hypothesis: The colour of the cable is changed depending on the amount of acid or alkali in the soil.

translations.source: Ana nuna matakin pH ta hanyar yawan sinadarin Hydrogen (na H a cikin pH) kwayoyin dake cikin sunadaran da aka gwada.
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.hypothesis: The pH level is indicated by the amount of hydrogen (H in pH) ions in a solution.

translations.source: Sinadiran Hydrogen sune proton wadanda suka cire wa Electrons (tunda sunadaran Hydrogen sun kunshi proton daya da electron daya).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen atoms are made of one proton and one electron (since hydrogen is the simplest and most abundant element in the universe).

translations.source: A juya hodojin tare, sannan a sa hannu mai dan danshi a cura su zuwa dan kwallo.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: Turn the balls over and hand them to the next player.

translations.source: Laimar da ke hannayenka za ta haɗe da fatar waje, inda zai zama abin nishaɗi kuma zai haifar da wani rin kwanso.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: The stick in your hand will be an extension of your body, as you'll be able to make it do things you never thought possible.

translations.source: Biranen Harappa da Mohenjo-daro suna da banɗaki mai ruwa a kusan kowane gida, wanda su ke haɗe wani kyakkyawa tsarin magudanar najasa.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a sophisticated water management system with each house having its own well and connected to a central drainage system.

translations.source: An samo ragowar tsarin shara a gidajen biranen Minoan na Crete da Santorini da ke Girka.
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: The earliest known examples of toilets were found in the homes of the Minoan civilization of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

translations.source: Hakanan akwai bandakuna a zamanin d Misira, Farisa da China. A cikin wayewar Roman, wasu lokuta bayan gida wani bangare ne na gidajen wanka na jama'a inda maza da mata suke tare a cikin haɗin gwiwa.
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.hypothesis: There were also bathhouses in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In the Roman empire, bathhouses were sometimes part of a public building where men and women would bathe together in a communal setting.

translations.source: Lokacin da kuka kira wanda yake da nisan duban mil kuna amfani da tauraron dan adam.
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When you call someone who lives thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.

translations.source: Tauraron dan adam a sararin samaniya yana samun kira sannan yana nuna shi baya ƙasa, kusan nan take.
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.hypothesis: The human-made object in space is being tracked and is viewable from Earth with the naked eye.

translations.source: An aika tauraron dan adam zuwa sararin samaniya ta hanyar roka. Masana kimiyya suna amfani da madubin hangen nesa a sararin samaniya saboda yanayin duniya yana gurbata wasu haskenmu da kallo.
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.hypothesis: Humans have sent telescopes into space on rockets. Scientists use space telescopes because Earth's atmosphere distorts some of the light we see.

translations.source: Yana daukan katon kunbo fiye da tsawon kafa 100 domin sanya tauraron dan adam ko abin kawo nesa kusa a sararin sama.
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.hypothesis: It takes more than 100 carbon-fiber reinforced polymer segments to assemble a single star or solar sail.

translations.source: Gare garen ta canza duniyan a hanyoyi na ban mamaki. Abu mafi girma da gare garen ta yi mana shine ta bamu hanyoyi masu sauki na sufuri.
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.hypothesis: The wheel changed the world in amazing ways. The greatest thing the wheel ever did for us was give us a way to move things easily.

translations.source: Lamarin ne ya kawo mana jirgin kasa, mota da hanyoyin sufuri da dama.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: The event also provided an excellent opportunity to showcase the country's rich cultural heritage through a variety of artistic performances, including music, dance, and theatre.

translations.source: Karkashin su akwai wasu maguna masu matsakaicin yanayi wadanda ke cin abinci mai madaidaicin yanayi wanda ya fara daga zomaye zuwa barewa da barewan daji.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: They are preyed upon by a number of mid-sized carnivores including the fossa, and also by humans.

translations.source: Da karshe, akwai kananan kyanwoyi (da suka haɗa da kyanwoyin gida da suka gudu) da suke cin kananan naman da suka kama kamar kwari, ɓeraye, kadangaru, da tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are smaller carnivores (including domestic dogs and foxes) that prey on smaller animals such as rodents, hares, rabbits and poultry.

translations.source: Sirrin nasararsu ita ce tsarinsu na samun hutu, aiki na musamman da kowace kyanwa ke riko da shi domin kaucewa yin gasa da sauran.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: Their success is in their ability to carve a unique niche for themselves, far from the madding crowd of competitors.

translations.source: Zakuna ne dangin mage da suka fi daɗin ma’amala, suna taruwa wuri ɗaya abin da ake kira iko.
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: The monkeys are very social animals, living in troops called harems.

translations.source: Garken zaki sun kunshi maza manya daya zuwa uku masu dangantaka, tare da mata da dama har zuwa talatin tare da ‘ya’ya.
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: Harems consist of one to three males related to each other, and several females up to thirty with their young.

translations.source: Mata yawanci suna da kusanci da juna, kasancewa babban dangi na yan uwa da ƴaƴa mata.
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: Women are often very close to their mothers-in-law, being the primary female relatives in the extended family.

translations.source: Taruwar zakuna suna kamar rukunin kyar ko karnuka, dabbobi wanda suka yi kamar da zaki (amma ba sauran manyan kuliyoyi ba) a cikin hali, kuma suna da matukar cutarwa ga abincin su.
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: The order Squamata includes lizards and snakes, which are reptiles (though not all reptiles are scaly) and are very diverse in their feeding habits.

translations.source: Mai gudu sosai, damisa zai iya hawa (amma ba maikyau ba) yi iwo, tsalen nesa sosai da kuma ja so biya kamar kafin mutum.
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: A fast, quiet, relatively inexpensive way to travel long distances, and often cheaper than flying.

translations.source: Damisar Tiger tana cikin rukuni guda (Genus Panthera) kamar zakuna, damisar leopards, da jaguars. Wadannan dangin kyanwar guda huɗu sune kaɗai su ke iya ruri.
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: The tiger is one of the world's largest cat species, and is part of the genus Panthera, which also includes lions, leopards and jaguars. These four subspecies of big cats are the only ones that can roar.

translations.source: Rurin damisa bai yi kama da cikeke ƙarfin murya zaki ba, amma ya fi kama da gurnani na jimlar kalmomin da aka faɗa da ƙarfi.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: Ease of learning doesn't necessarily mean learning a few words, but rather the amount of words that can be learned in a certain amount of time.

translations.source: Ƴan wasa suna son cin kananan dabbobi. Za su kama birai, macizai, zazzage da tsuntsaye in sun iya. Kusan dukkan dabbobin da dutsen ya farauto suna ƙasa da shi.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: The players like to eat the small animals. They will catch fish, frogs, lizards and birds if they can. Most of the animals that live on the mountain are below it.

translations.source: Masana ilimin kimiyya suna tunanin cewa ocelots na bin dabbobi da kama su ta hanyar sansanar sawun inda su ka bi su ka wuce.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists think ocelots hunt and kill their prey by chasing them up trees.

translations.source: Suna iya gani sosai cikin duhu tare da ganin na dare, kuma suna tafiya cikin sanɗa. Kyanwar daji na farautar abin farautar su ta hanyar sajewa da wurin da su ke sannan su dirar wa abin farautar su.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: They can see well in the dark with their night vision, and they move about in herds. The forest elephant forages for its food by browsing and stripping off leaves and twigs.

translations.source: Yayin da wani karamin gungun dabbobi (jama’a kadan) su ka kasance sun rabu da babban gungun da su ke ciki (misali idan su ka koma kan wasu jerin tsaunuka, ko wani kogi ko kuma su ka koma wani sabon tsibirin yadda ba zasu iya komowa ba) akasari su kan sami kansu a muhalli na daban da inda su ka fito.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When a small number of animals (a few individuals) become separated from the main group (for example, if they cross a mountain range, a river, or a new island and can no longer return) they may find themselves in a new environment to which they are not well adapted.

translations.source: Wannan sabon muhallin yana da albarkatu daban da kuma masu gasa daban, don haka sabuwar al’umma za ta buƙaci mabambantan fasali ko karɓuwa don zama ƙaƙƙarfar mai gasafiye da abin da su ka buƙata a baya.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the startup will need new features or adaptations to be a good product for this new market.

translations.source: Asalin al’umman basu canza ba ko kadan, suna bukatan karbuwa kamar da.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The original natives were not changed in the least, but required only to be received as they were.

translations.source: A kan lokaci, yayin da sabbin yawan jama’a suka fara daidaita da sabon yanayin su, sai su fara dawo kadan da kadan kamar waɗancan yawan jama'a.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as the new population becomes better adapted to the new environment, they begin to evolve away from the ancestral population.

translations.source: A ƙarshe, bayan dubun dubbai ko ma shekaru miliyoyi, yawar jama’a biyu za su zauna da banbancin da ba za a kira su da wannan jinsin ba.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, after thousands or millions of years, the two populations will become so different that they will no longer be able to interbreed.

translations.source: Samar da sabon jinsi, hanya ce mai mahimmanci wadda ba za’a iya kauce mata ba a cikin tsarin asalin halittu.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: Speciation is an inevitable process in the theory of evolution.

translations.source: Shuke-shuke suna sanya iskar oxygen wanda mutane ke shaka, kuma suna shan iskar carbon-dioxide wanda mutane ke fitarwa (ma'ana fitar da iska).
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce the oxygen that people breathe, and they take in carbon dioxide, a gas that people breathe out.

translations.source: Tsire-tsire suna yin abincinsu daga rana ta hanyar hotuna. Suna kuma bayar da inuwa.
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants make their own food from sunlight. They also give off oxygen.

translations.source: Muna gina gidajenmu ne daga itatuwa kuma muna yin sitirunmu daga itatuwa. Mafi yawan abincin da muke ci daga tsirrai ne. Idan babu tsirrai, mutane da dabbobi ba za su rayu ba.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our homes from trees and make our furniture from trees. Most of the food we eat comes from plants. If there were no plants, people and animals could not live.

translations.source: Mosasaurus ita ce babbar dabbar da ke farautar dabbobi a zamaninta, don haka bata fargabar komi ba, in ban da dabbobin Mosasaurs.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: The Mosasaur was the top predator of its time, so it had no natural enemies, except maybe other Mosasaurs.

translations.source: Dogon haban sa sun cika da hakora masu ci kamar reza sama da 70, tare da ƙarin saiti a cikin rufin bakinsa, ma'ana babu mafaka ga wani abu wanda ya ketare hanyar sa.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: Its long neck is filled with about 70 vertebrae, with extra-long processes extending from the base of the neck, meaning there is no room for anything else to go down the throat.

translations.source: Bamuda tabbaci amma watakila yana da harshe me cokali me yatsu. abincin shi ya hada dodon kodi, manyan kifaye, da wasu masosaurs kuma zai iya akwai mai cin nama.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: There's no certainty but it probably had a mixed diet of roots, tubers, fruits and possibly some meat.

translations.source: Ta na kai wa duk wani abu farmaki da ya shiga ruwan, ko da kuwa gabjejen kakan kadangare mai suna T.Rex ba zai iya ja da shi ba.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: It is capable of attacking anything that enters its domain, even if it is just a tiny T. rex.

translations.source: Duk da yake yawancin abincinsu zai zama sananne gare mu, Romawa suna da nasu yankin na baƙin bukukuwa ko abubuwan biki da ba a saba da su ba, da suka haɗa da akuyar daji, dawisu, dodon-koɗi, da kuma wani nau’in ɓera da ake kira dormousee
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: While much of their cuisine would be familiar to us, the Romans had their own unique range of party and banquet foods, including dormice, peacocks, sausages, and a type of dormouse called a nucellus

translations.source: Wani banbamcin kuma shi ne talakawa da kuma mata sun cinye abincinsu yayin da suke zaune a kan kujeru, masu hannu da shuni kuma suna son cin abinci tare a inda suke zama a manya-manyan dakunan shakatawa domin cin abincin.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: Another distinction is that the poor and women tend to eat out while the young and single prefer to eat out at fast food restaurants.

translations.source: Cikin abubuwan da ake ci a tsohuwar daular Rum, ba zai kasance abincin da ya zo Turai daga Amurka ba ko kuma daga Asia a karnonin da su ka zo daga baya.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The cuisine of the former Roman empire was not the same as the cuisines that came to Europe from the Americas or Asia in later centuries.

translations.source: Alal misali, ba su da masara, babu tumatur, babu dankali. babu koko, kuma babu mutumin tsohuwar Rum da ya taɓa ɗanɗana talotalo.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, they have no maize, no tomatoes, no potatoes, no coconuts, and no old Roman who has tasted the artichoke.

translations.source: Yan Babylon sun gina wa kowanne allansu haikali da ya zama matsayin gidan allan.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built a temple to their god at the top of each ziggurat.

translations.source: Mutane za su kawo hadaya ga abubuwan bauta yayin da malaman bautar za su yi ƙoƙarin biyan buƙatun abubuwan bautar ta hanyar bukukuwa da shagulgula.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People would bring offerings to the idols while the priests would try to appease the gods through rituals and sacrifices.

translations.source: Kowane wajen bauta tana da budaden haraba tare da kebantaccen mihrabi wanda limamai kadai ke shiga.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each temple had its own resident priests and a special altar which only the priests were allowed to enter.

translations.source: Wasu lokuta an gina hasumiya na musamman mai siffar dala, wanda ake kira ziggurats, domin su zama sashi na haikali.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes special stepped pyramids, called ziggurats, were built as part of a temple complex.

translations.source: Saman hasumiyar wuri ne na musamman na abun bautan.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: The temple is a unique example of the architecture of the time.

translations.source: A cikin yanayi mai zafi na Gabas ta tsakiya, gida ba shi da matuƙar mahimmanci.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the hot, dry climate of the Middle East, the home is not so much a shelter from the elements.

translations.source: Yawancin rayuwar dangin Ibrananci sun faru ne a sararin sama.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the Hebrew characters are consonants.

translations.source: Mata sun yi girki a farfajiyar; shagunan buɗe ido ne kawai suna kallon titi. An yi amfani da dutse don gina gidaje.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: Women cooked outdoors; storefronts were shuttered and barred. The streets were paved with flagstones.

translations.source: Babu wani daji mai girma a ƙasar Kan'ana, saboda haka katako yana da tsada.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There are no large forests in the country, so timber is expensive.

translations.source: An zauna a Greenland a warwatse. A cikin yankin Norse sun ce an kori Erik the Red daga Iceland saboda kisan kai, kuma lokacin da ya kaɗa ya yi yamma, sai ya gano Greenland kuma ya ba ta suna Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland is inhabited sparsely. In the Norse Sagas it says that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when he sailed west he found Greenland and named it Greenland.

translations.source: Amma duk da ganowar sa, dama tuni ƙabilun Eskimo suna zaune a wurin a lokacin.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: But even at that early date, the Eskimo had already begun to move into the area.

translations.source: Kodayake kowace ƙasa ta kasance 'Scandinavia', akwai bambance-bambance masu yawa tsakanin mutane, sarakuna, al'adu da tarihin Denmark, Sweden, Norway da Iceland.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Although each country is considered "Scandinavian", there are many differences between the people, the languages, the cultures and the histories of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.

translations.source: Idan ka kalli majigi mai suna National Treasure, za ka yi tsamanin an rubuta taswirar taska a bayan takardan Ƙudurin ‘Yancin Kai.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you've seen the movie National Treasure, you might expect the Declaration to be written on the back of the painting.

translations.source: Sai dai kuma, wannan ba gaskiya ba ne. Duk da cewa akwai wani abu da aka rubuta a bayan daftarin, ba taswirar taskar arziki ba ce.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, this is not the case. Although there's a paper trail behind the token, it is not backed by any financial assets.

translations.source: An rubuta a bayan Bayanin Samun Ƴancin kai kalmomin “Asalin Sanarwar Samun' Yanci ne a ranar 4 ga Yuli 1776”. Rubutun ya bayyana a ƙasan takardar, juye.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The words "Original Declaration of Independence" are inscribed on the back of the document, which is hinged at the bottom.

translations.source: A yayin da babu takamaiman wanda ya rubuta shi, an sani cewa a farkon rayuwar shi, babban takardan (yana daukar ma'aunin inci 29¾ zuwa inci 24½) an nada shi don ajiya.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: While the exact author is unknown, it is known that in its early form, the codex (measuring about 29.7 by 24.5 cm) was meant to be stored.

translations.source: Don haka, da alama an ƙara tsarin rubutun ne kawai a matsayin laƙabi.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: So, the word "academy" was just a label.

translations.source: Saukar D-Day da yaƙe-yaƙe masu zuwa sun ƴantar da arewacin Faransa, amma har yanzu kudanci bai sami yanci ba.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The D-Day landings and subsequent battles liberated most of the north of France, but the south was still under German control.

translations.source: Faransawa '' Vichy '' suka mallake shi. Waɗannan mutanen Faransa ne waɗanda suka yi sulhu da Jamusawa a 1940 kuma suka yi aiki tare da masu mamaye maimakon yaƙar su.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: It was occupied by the French "Vichy" government. These were French people who had made a deal with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders rather than fight them.

translations.source: A ranar 15 ga watan Agusta 1940, Kawayen sun mamaye kudancin Faransa, mamayar da aka yi wa lakabi da sunan “Operation Dragoon”.
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15, 1944, the Allies invaded southern France in a move code-named "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: A cikin makonni biyu kawai Amurkawa da Sojojin Faransa na ƴancin faransa suka ƴantar da kudancin Faransa kuma suka juya zuwa Jamus.
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Within two weeks, American and Free French forces liberated southern France and turned toward Germany.

translations.source: Wayewa al’ada ce guda wadda mutane da dama da ke zama da aiki tare na daukan nasu ce, al’umma.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: A culture is a group of people and the shared practices, values, and beliefs that characterize them.

translations.source: Kalmar civilization ta zo ne daga kalmar latin civilis, ma’ana farar hula, mai dangantaka da civis na Latin, ma’ana yan kasa, da cavitas, ma’ana birni ko birnin-jiha, kuma yana ba da adadin yawan jama’a.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word civilization comes from the Latin civitas, meaning citizenship, from civis, meaning city-dweller, and from cavitas, meaning a cavity or hollow, and by extension a city or town, and finally the population or inhabitants of a particular area.

translations.source: Biranen gari sune kashin bayan al'ummomi. Al'adar wayewar tana nuna wucewar ilimi a cikin tsararraki da yawa, rabe-raben al'adu da rarraba gaskiya.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: Oral traditions are the lifeblood of communities. The art of oral storytelling transmits knowledge through generations, preserving cultural values and moral codes.

translations.source: kananun al’adu galibi su kan shuɗe ba tare da barin tabbatattun shaidu na tarihi ba kuma ba a saka su cikin jerin manyan zamunna.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: The earliest cultures are often lost to the geologic record and are not included in the geologic time scale.

translations.source: A lokacin Yaƙin Juyin Juya Hali, jihohi goma sha ukun sun kafa gwamnatin tsakiya mai rauni - wadda ta kunshi Majalisa kawai - a ƙarƙashin dokar gwamnatin hadin gwiwa.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the War of Independence, thirteen colonies established a weak central government—a Congress—under the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: Majalisa ba ta da wani iko na kakaba haraji, sannan kuma, kasancewar babu ɓangarorin zartaswa da na shari’a na ƙasar, ta dogara ne kan hukumomin jihohi, waɗanda mafi yawanci ba sa bayar da haɗin kai, wajen ganin an tilasta aiki da dokokin.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The legislature has no direct taxing power, and, lacking a fully developed executive and judicial branch, it is dependent on state institutions, which are often uncoordinated, to implement its laws.

translations.source: Hakanan ba ta da ikon yin watsi da dokokin haraji da haraji tsakanin jihohi.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: It also lacks the ability to set or levy taxes and cross-state taxes.

translations.source: Labaran sun buƙaci yarjejeniya baki ɗaya daga dukkan jihohin kafin a iya gyara su kuma jihohi sun ɗauki gwamnatin tarraya a sauƙaƙe cewa wakilansu ba su nan.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: The news reports demanded a unanimous agreement from all states before they could be amended and the states took the opportunity to conveniently disown their representatives.

translations.source: Masu kwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Italiya, tare da ƙungiyar ƙwallon ƙafa ta ƙasar Jamus ita ce ta biyu mafi nasara a duniya kuma sun kasance zakarun ƙwallon ƙafa na FIFA a 2006.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: Italy's national football team, nicknamed the Azzurri, are the second most successful national team in the world and were crowned FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.

translations.source: Shahararrun wasanni sun hada da kwallon kafa, kwallon kwando, wasan kwallon raga, wasan ruwa, wasan takobi, wasan kwallon rugby, tseren kekuna, kwallon gora, wasan kwallon gorar kankara da na tseren motoci na F1.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include soccer, basketball, baseball, water sports, track and field, rugby, cycling, golf, ice hockey and Formula 1 car racing.

translations.source: Wasannin hunturu sun shahara a yankuna na Arewa, inda da Italiyawa su ke fafatawa a wasannin kasa da kasa da wasannin Olympic.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: Winter sports are popular in the northern regions, where Italy has competed in international and Olympic events.

translations.source: Japans suna riƙe da kusan tsibirai 7,000 (babba shine Honshu), yana mai sanya Japan tsibiri na 7 mafi girma a duniya!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan consists of 7,000+ islands (the largest is Honshu), making it the 7th largest island country in the world!

translations.source: Saboda tari/rukunin tsibirai da Japan ke da su, sau da yawa akan kira Japan, a matsayin yanki, da suna “tarin tsibirai”.
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to the many islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, as a region, as the "Archipelago".

translations.source: Farkon Taiwan ya faro tun baya cikin karni na 15 inda Turawa matukan jirgin ruwa da ke wucewa suka ɗauki sunan tsibirin a matsayin IIha Formosa, ko kyakyawan tsibiri.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: The first Europeans to arrive in Taiwan were Portuguese sailors in the 15th century who named the island Formosa, meaning "beautiful island".

translations.source: A cikin 1624, Kamfanin Dutch East India Company ya kafa tushe a kudu maso yammacin Taiwan, yana ƙaddamar da canji a cikin ayyukan noman hatsi na asali da ɗaukar ma'aikata na China don yin aiki a gonakin shinkafa da sukari.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a trading post in southwestern Taiwan, sparking a shift in the island's agricultural activities and the employment of Chinese labourers on sugar plantations.

translations.source: A shekarar 1683, sojojin daular Qing (1644-1912) sun kwace ikon lardin Taiwan na yammacin da arewacin gabar teku, suka ayyana Taiwan a matsayin lardin daular Qing a shekarar 1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing Dynasty (1644-1912) forces captured Taiwan's west coast and in 1885 formally declared Taiwan a province of the Qing Dynasty.

translations.source: A shekarar 1895, bayan kayarwa a cikin Farkon Yaƙin Sino-Japanese (1894-1895), gwamnatin Qing su sa-hannu a Yarjejeniyar Shimonoseki, ta wanda ta bayar da mulkin kan Taiwan zuwa ga Japan, wanda ya yi mulkin tsibirin har 1945.
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: In 1895, after losing the First Sino-Japanese War (1894–1895), the Qing government was forced to sign the Treaty of Shimonoseki, which ceded Taiwan to Japan, who ruled the island until 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu ya hada da tsari uku, masu suna Intihuatana, Temple of the Sun, da Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu contains three distinct architectural groups, known as the Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.

translations.source: An sake gina mafi yawan gine-ginen da ke gefen rukunin ginin domin ƴan yawon buɗe ido su fahimci yadda asalin siffarsu ta ke.
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the buildings on the site have been rebuilt to allow visitors to understand how the original structures looked.

translations.source: Zuwa shekarar 1976, an farfado da kashi talatin na gine ginen Machu Picchu kuma har yanzu ana ci gaba da aikin.
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and work continues to this day.

translations.source: A misali, nau’in hoto marar motsi da aka fi sani a duniya shi ne 35mm, wanda shi ne girman fim na hoto da aka fi amfani da shi a ƙarshen zamanin fim ɗin hannu.
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common motion picture film format in the world is 35 mm, which is the standard film format used in the last decades of the 20th century.

translations.source: Har yau din nan ana sarrafa shi, amma muhimmin abu a nan kyamarar komi da ruwanka ce ta gaje shi da ke sunsuno hotuna.
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: The coin is also processed, but the main thing is the camera and the blockchain behind it.

translations.source: Abin mamaki shine zubin 35mm a haƙiƙa fadin 36mm ya ke da shi da kuma tsawon 24mm.
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, a 35mm negative is actually 36mm by 24mm in size.

translations.source: A lissafin wannan tsarin (idan aka raba sha biyu domin samun adadi mafi karancin lamba) zai kasance a daidaiton 3:2.
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: The balance of this system (if divided equally) would be 3:2.

translations.source: Yawancin hanyoyin gama gari na yau da kullun (misali tsarin APS na iyali) ya kusa da wannan tsari.
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Most common approaches (e.g. family planning programmes) are only partially aligned with this approach.

translations.source: Dokar da aka fi rainawa itace dokar gina dynamism tare da tabbatar da tsarin a hoto.
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: The law that was voted for was the one to build dynamically and ensure visual consistency.

translations.source: Ya bayyana cewa wuri mafi mahimmanci a darasin shine mahadar layuka wanda ya raba hoton a tsaye da kuma a kwance (duba misali).
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: He points out that the most important part of the lesson is the hinge which is the split between the vertical and horizontal (see example).

translations.source: A wannan lokaci na tarihin Tarayyan Turai, cocin Katolika, wadda ta yi ƙarfi da arziki, ta fuskanci bincike.
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: At this time in European history, the powerful and wealthy Catholic Church was experiencing a crisis.

translations.source: Sama da shekara dubu addinin Kirista ya haɗe kasashen Turai waje guda duk da banbance banbance na harsuna da ala’adu.
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: Christianity has united Europe for over a thousand years despite linguistic and cultural differences.

translations.source: Ƙarfin barnansa ta shafe kowa daga sarki har na gama-gari.
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: Its destructive power affected everyone from the king down to the commoner.

translations.source: Daya daga cikin shishikan addinin krista shine yin amfani da arziki wajen magance matsaloli da kuma yakar talauci sannan kuma jami’in kudi na cocin suna can musamman saboda wannan dalilin.
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the main goals of Christianity is to use one's resources to solve problems and fight poverty and the church's financial officers are there primarily for that purpose.

translations.source: Babban cibiyar shugabancin coci ta kasance a Roma sama da dubban shekaru kuma mayar da arziki da mulki can ya jawo cece-kuce game da ko ana bin wannan shikashikin.
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: The central church leadership has always been in Rome and the wealth and power concentrated there has always been a source of tension over whether the church should be run from there.

translations.source: Jim kaɗan bayan ɓarkewar tashin hankalin, Birtaniya ta fara toshe mashigan ruwa na Jamus.
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain began to impose a naval blockade on Germany.

translations.source: Dabarun sun yi tasiri, hana shigar da muhimman kayayyakin soja da na farar hulla, ko da yake wannan toshewa ta sabawa dokoki na ƙasa da ƙasa waɗanda yarjejeniyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama na ƙarnoni biyu da suka wuce suka tsara.
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The resolutions are effective, preventing the transfer of major military and dual-use goods, although this restriction is qualified by international law which requires that any such interference must be “strictly limited in scope and duration.”

translations.source: Birtaniya ta dasa bama bamai a teku domin hana jiragen ruwa shiga wannan yanki na teku, abinda ke da hadari ga jiragen yan baruwanmu.
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: The British had laid mines in the approaches to the harbour, which was a risk to our ships.

translations.source: Tunda aka samu karancin sakamako ga wannan dabarun, Jamus tayi tsammanin sakamako irin haka zuwa ga yakin kasan tekun da bashi da kayyadewa.
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: Since the results of this tactic were unsatisfactory, Germany expected similar results to an unrestricted submarine warfare.

translations.source: A lokacin 1920s, halaye mafi rinjaye na yawancin ƴan ƙasa da ƙasashe shine na zaman lafiya da keɓewa.
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1920s, the most common ideologies of most citizens and countries were peace and isolation.

translations.source: Bayan ganin munanan abubuwa da munanan yaƙe-yaƙe yayin Yaƙin Duniya na ɗaya, al'ummomi sun so su guje wa irin wannan yanayin a nan gaba.
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: After witnessing the horrors and destruction of World War I, communities sought ways to avoid such conflicts in the future.

translations.source: A cikin 1884, Tesla ya koma Amurka don karɓar aiki tare da Kamfanin Edison a cikin New York City.
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884, Tesla emigrated to the United States to work for Edison in New York City.

translations.source: Ya iso Amurka da sulai 4 kacal, da wani littafin wakoki, da wasikar gabatarwa daga Charles Batchelor (manajansa a aikin da ya bari) zuwa ga Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: He arrived in the United States with only four dollars, a songbook, and a letter of introduction from Charles Batchelor (his former employer) to Thomas Edison.

translations.source: Ƙasar China ta zamanin da tana da wata hanyar musamman ta nuna lokutan yanayi daban-daban; kowane mataki na China ko kowane iyali da ya hau karagar mulki to shi ma daula ce ta daban.
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Dynastic China had a unique way of indicating different eras; each emperor or ruling family had their own unique name for their era.

translations.source: Haka nan tsakanin kowace daula a kan sami lokaci na rashin zaman lafiya tsakanin larduna. Fitacce daga waɗannan zamuna shi ne zamanin Masarautu Uku da ya faru tsawon shekaru 60 tsakanin Daular Han da ta Jin.
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: There was also a period of interregnum between each of these dynasties. The most notable of these was the Warring States Period which lasted for about 60 years between the Han and Jin dynasties.

translations.source: A wancan lokaci yaki ya barke tsakanin mafi yawan gidajen sarauta da ke hankoron kujerar sarki.
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.hypothesis: At that time there was a succession crisis among the royal families.

translations.source: Masarauta Uku ya kasance daya daga cikin zamunan da aka fi zub da jini a tarihin Tsohuwar China dubban mutane sun mutu suna gwagwarmaya don zama a kan madaukakiyar kujera a babbar fada a Xi’an.
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: The Terracotta Army is one of the most important archaeological sites in the world, and is a major tourist attraction in Xi’an.

translations.source: Akwai tasiri na zamantakewa da siyasa masu yawa kamar amfani da tsarin awo cikakke, barin kama-karya zuwa jamhuriyya, kishin ƙasa tare da imanin cewa ƙasar ta mutanen ƙasa ce ba mutum ɗaya mai mulki ba.
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.hypothesis: There are many social and political effects such as the use of propaganda, the transition from autocracy to democracy, nationalism and the belief that the nation is more important than any individual.

translations.source: Hakanan bayan juyin halin an bude ayyuka ga duk maza masu neman aiki inda hakan ya bada dama ga masu buri da kokari su sami cigaba.
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.hypothesis: The internship opportunities are open to male and female applicants, providing a level playing field for ambitious individuals to gain valuable experience and make meaningful connections.

translations.source: Hakanan ya kasance ga sojoji saboda maimakon martaba sojoji ya kasance bisa la'akari da aji sai yanzu suka dogara da cailaber.
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: It was also extended to the military because the military ranks were based on class and now they are based on merit.

translations.source: Juyin Juya Hali na Faransa ya kuma ba sauran wasu mutane masu tsananin ƙarfi na wata ƙasa damar fara nasu juyin juya halin.
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.hypothesis: The French Revolution also provided other oppressed people in other countries with the inspiration to start their own revolutions.

translations.source: Muhammadu yana matukar sha'awar al'amuran da suka wuce rayuwar wannan duniya. Ya na yawan ziyarar kogon da a ka fi sani da na “Hira” a tsaunin “Noor” (wato haske) domin kadaicewa yayi tunani.
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad was also interested in metaphysical subjects. He often visited a cave in the mountain of Noor (light) to meditate and reflect.

translations.source: ya ɓoye kansa, wanda ya rayu a lokacin, yana ba da hoton karkatawar ruhaniyar Muhammad a tsarari.
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.hypothesis: He hid his face, which was a living portrait of the Prophet Muhammad's features.

translations.source: Kasancewa a saman ɗayan duwatsun arewacin Makka, kogon ya zama ya keɓe daga sauran duniya.
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.hypothesis: Perched atop a high plateau in the north of the holy city of Mecca, the monastery is a world away from the bustle of the city.

translations.source: A hakika akwai matukar wahalar gano wajen ko ma ka idan ka san ya kasance. Kana shiga cikin kogon zaka ji kadaita ta kama ka.
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.hypothesis: It is quite hard to find a place to sit down, even if you know where to look. You're in for a surprise if you think you can just walk in and grab a seat.

translations.source: Babu abin da za a iya gani face kyakkyawan sararin samaniya da tsaunuka masu yawa da ke kewayen. Baka iya ji ko ganin wadannan daga cikin kogon.
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.hypothesis: There's nothing to see but the black sky and the stars and the mountains all around. You can't hear or feel anything from inside the capsule.

translations.source: Babban alwatikan a Giza shine kawai ɗayan abubuwan al'ajabi bakwai da har yanzu suke tsaye a yau.
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World still standing today.

translations.source: Babban Masarautar da Masarawa suka gina a ƙarni na uku KZ, Babban alwatika yana ɗayan manyan gine-ginen dala da aka gina don girmama Fir'auna da ya mutu.
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza, built in the Third Dynasty of the Old Kingdom, is the oldest and largest of the Giza pyramid complex, and is the only one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World still standing.

translations.source: Giza Plateau, ko “Giza Necropolls” a Kwarin Massar na matattu yana kunshe da dala iri-iri ( wanda babban dala shine mafi girma), yawancin kananan kaburbura, gidajen bauta, da babban gunkin Sphinx.
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Arabic, is home to several Old Kingdom pyramids, most notably the Great Pyramid of Giza, the only remaining wonder of the ancient world, as well as the Great Sphinx.

translations.source: Babbar dalar an kafa ta ne domin girmama Fir’auna Khufu, kuma da daman cikinsu da kushewu da wuraren ibada an gina su ne domin matan Khufu tare da iyalan gidansa.
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built to honor the pharaoh Khufu, and the surrounding complex of tombs and temples was built to house Khufu's family and household.

translations.source: Alamar “kwarin sama” ta yi kama da V sannan “alamar kwarin ƙasa” kamar maɗauri ne ko murabba’i da ya kuskure gefen ƙasan ta.
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.hypothesis: The "up" symbol is similar to the letter V and the "down" symbol is like an inverted V or a square with the bottom side missing.

translations.source: Sama yana nufin ya kamata ka fara daga sama ka tura bakan, sannan kasan yana nufin ka fara daga kwado (wanda shine inda hannunka ke rike da baka) ka ja bakan.
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.hypothesis: Top-down means starting from the top of the blade and pulling the blade towards the hilt, while bottom-up means starting from the hilt and pulling the blade up.

translations.source: Yawancin lokoci up-bow na fitar da murya mai laushi, haka kuma down-bow na da ƙarfi da tabatarwa sosai.
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.hypothesis: The up-bow produces a light, airy tone, while the down-bow is heavier and more sustained.

translations.source: Ka saki jikinka wajen bada naka makin, amma kar ka manta makin da aka buga su na da dalilai na kida, don haka ya kamata a girmama su.
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.hypothesis: Feel free to show off your best moves, but keep in mind that the music has cultural significance and should be respected.

translations.source: A firgice Sarki Louis da Sarauniya Marie Antoinette da yayansu guda biyu (Marie yar shekaru 11 da kuma Louis-Charles dan shekara hudu) da kuma yar'uwar Sarki, Madam Elizabeth, wadanda matan kasuwa masu bore a ranar 6 ga watan Oktoba 1789 sun tilasta musu komawa birnin Faris daga garin Versailles.
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.hypothesis: On the night of 5–6 October 1789, a mob of market women marched to the Palace of Versailles and demanded that King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette, and their two children (11-year-old Marie and four-year-old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madame Elisabeth, return with them to Paris.

translations.source: A cikin tarago, suka koma zuwa Paris zagaye da wasu gungun mutane da ke ihu suna kalaman barazanar a kan Sarki da Sarauniya.
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.hypothesis: In the Tuileries, they ran into a group of people shouting threats against the King and Queen.

translations.source: Tarin mutanen ya tilastawa sarkin da sarauniyar bude tagogin abun hawan nasu.
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
