translations.reference: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.hypothesis: The word safari is closely associated with the adventure of seeing the wildlife of Africa, especially in the open plains and savannas.

translations.source: Wasu dabbobi, kamar giwaye da raƙuman dawa, su kan je kusa da motoci kuma na’ura mai kyau za ta ba da damar kallo sosai.
translations.reference: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.hypothesis: Some animals, like the walrus and arctic fox, are naturally curious and will approach vehicles and give good photo opportunities.

translations.source: Zakuna, damisar cheetah da ta leopard wasu lokuta suna kaucewa mutane kuma za ku fi ganin su sosai maduban hangen nesa.
translations.reference: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.hypothesis: Zebras, cheetahs and leopards are more wary of humans and are more easily scared away at a distance.

translations.source: Safari na tafiya (wanda ake kira “tafiyar daji”, “safari maiyawo”, ko tafiya “ƙafa”) ya ƙunshi yin yawo, ko dai na awanni ko kwanaki da yawa.
translations.reference: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.hypothesis: Hiking (also known as "bushwalking", "trekking", or "hill walking") involves walking in natural environments, typically for more than an hour or two, and often for multiple days.

translations.source: Za a gudanar da wasannin nakasassu daga 24 ga Agusta zuwa 5 ga Satumba 2021. Za a gudanar da wasu abubuwan a wasu wurare a duk fadin Japan.
translations.reference: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.hypothesis: The Paralympic Games will be held from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held at other venues across Japan.

translations.source: Tokyo za ta kasance gari daya tilo na Asiya da ya taba karbar bakuncin wasannin Olympics karo biyu, bayan da ta dauki nauyin wasannin a shekarar 1964.
translations.reference: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.hypothesis: Tokyo will be the first Asian city to have hosted the Olympic Games twice, after it hosted the event in 1964.

translations.source: Idan kayi rijistar tashin jirgi da masauki a 2020 kafin sanar da jinkirtawa, zaku iya samun matsala.
translations.reference: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.hypothesis: If you book a flight and hotel in 2020 before the announcement of the travel ban, you may be out of luck.

translations.source: Manufofin sokewa sun bambanta, amma har zuwa ƙarshen Maris yawancin manufofin sakewa na coronavirus ba su wuce zuwa Yuli 2020, lokacin da aka shirya wasannin Olympics.
translations.reference: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.hypothesis: The purchase orders were issued with varying dates, but most of the coronavirus vaccine orders extended only to July 2020, the time of the Olympics.

translations.source: Ana tsammanin yawancin tikiti na sha’ani za a sayar da su tsakanin ¥2,500 zuwa ¥130,000, yayin da tikiti na yau da kullun su ke kusan ¥ 7,000.
translations.reference: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: Most regular tickets are expected to sell for between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, while a standard single-journey ticket costs around ¥7,000.

translations.source: Gugan kayayyakin sawa masu lema su a iya taimaka masu bushewa. Yawancin otal suna da dutsen guga da katakon guga kaya don rance, ko da ba wani a cikin ɗakin ba.
translations.reference: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.hypothesis: A good supply of absorbent material is necessary for bedding. Most hotels have a supply of hot water bottles and blankets, even if they do not have central heating.

translations.source: Idan ba a samu dutsen guga ba, ko kuma idan ba ku damu da saka gogaggiyar safa ba, to za ku iya gwada amfani da mabushin gashi, idan akwai.
translations.reference: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.hypothesis: If you don't have a rock, or if you don't care about putting a fossil in a frame, you can try using a hair clip, if available.

translations.source: Yi hankali da ƙin barin masana'anta suyi zafi sosai (wanda zai iya haifar da raguwa, ko kuma a mawuyacin yanayi, zafi).
translations.reference: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.hypothesis: Take care to avoid overheating the engine (which can cause damage, or in extreme cases, heat stroke).

translations.source: Akwai hanyoyi daban-daban na tsarkake ruwa, wasu sun fi tasiri kan takamaiman barazanar.
translations.reference: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.hypothesis: There are different methods of water purification, some more appropriate for specific risk factors.

translations.source: A wasu wurare, minti daya ya isa ruwa ya tafasa, amma a wasu wuraren kuma yana bukatar mintuna da yawa.
translations.reference: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.hypothesis: In some places, one minute is enough to boil water, but in other places it may take several minutes.

translations.source: Matata sun bambanta a inganci, idan kana da damuwa, to sai ka yi tunanin sayan naka ruwa a kwalba mai murfi daga amintaccen kamfani.
translations.reference: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.hypothesis: Quality varies considerably, so if you are concerned, consider buying bottled water from a reputable brand.

translations.source: Matafiya na iya fuskantar kwari wadanda basu saba dasu ba a garin su na asali.
translations.reference: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers may be exposed to allergens to which they are not accustomed in their home environment.

translations.source: Beraye da dangoginsu kan bata abinci sannan su janyo kaikayi ko kuma ma su haddasa kan jiki tare da yada guba ko kuma ma baza cututtuka.
translations.reference: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.hypothesis: Bites by infected animals can cause severe pain and swelling, and lead to disability or even death through the spread of infection or disease.

translations.source: Cututuka masu iya yaduwa da kansu, ko kuma dabbobi da ke da hatsari da za su iya raunatawa ko kashe mutane da ƙarfi, ba su cancanta a matsayin kwari ba.
translations.reference: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.hypothesis: Diseases that are transmissible to humans, or animals that are dangerous to humans and likely to injure or kill unprovoked, are not considered pets.

translations.source: Sayan kaya ta rahusa ita ce damar siyan kayan da aka kebe daga haraji da fifcewa a wasu wurare.
translations.reference: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.hypothesis: Duty-free shops are stores that sell goods at a lower price than other stores because they do not have to pay taxes.

translations.source: Matafiya zuwa ƙasashe masu tsananin haraji za su iya adana wani adadin kuɗin mai yawa a wasu lokuta n, musamman akan abubuwa kamar barasa da taba.
translations.reference: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers to high-tax countries may save money in the long run, especially on goods such as alcohol and tobacco.

translations.source: Yankin tsakanin Point Marion da Fairmont na gabatar da mafi kyawun yanayin tuƙi a kan babbar hanyar Buffalo-Pittsburgh, yana wucewa ta kowane yanki mai zaman kansa da baya.
translations.reference: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The stretch of the National Road between Point Marion and Fairmont offers the best remaining example of a typical early National Pike Road, passing through small towns and the countryside.

translations.source: Idan har ba ka saba da tuki a titunan kasar ba, to ka tattara hankalinka a kanka: kana mai hankalta da tukin da nutsuwa a titin tare da kaucewa tukin gaggawa da daga hankali.
translations.reference: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.hypothesis: If you're not used to driving on the right, be extra careful: pay attention to the traffic and keep to the right, signalling well in advance when you want to overtake.

translations.source: Alamomin kayyade gudun ababen hawa sun yi karanci a nan fiye da a wuraren da ke baya - anfi samun wadanda ba sa wuce mph 35-40 (56-64 km/h) - biyayya ga alamomin na da mahimmanci maimakon rashin yi musu biyayya.
translations.reference: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.hypothesis: Speed limits are less of an issue here than in most other places - most roads have a speed limit of 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) - and observing the speed limits is more a matter of courtesy than law.

translations.source: Abin ban mamaki, ko da yake, sabis ɗin wayar hannu ya fi ƙarfi a nan fiye da sauran hanyoyin da yawa, misali. Daji na Pennsylvania.
translations.reference: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Interestingly, though, the mobile service is superior here to most other methods, e.g. landlines in Pennsylvania.

translations.source: Kayan ciye-ciyen Jamusawa akwai kyau, kuma a Bavaria, suna da daɗin gaske da mabambanta, irin na maƙwabciyarsu ta kudanci, Austria.
translations.reference: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: German food is hearty and wholesome, and in Bavaria, it is as rich and varied as that of its neighbour to the south, Austria.

translations.source: Abincin ƴaƴan itace sun zama ruwan dare, ta yin abinci da tufa a tsawon shekara, da kuma cherries da plums da ke bayyana lokacin bazara.
translations.reference: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.hypothesis: The fruit of the trees are a welcome sight, providing a year-round supply of food, and the cherries and plums are a summer treat.

translations.source: Yawancin kayayyaki da aka dafa da Jamusanci suma suna da alamomin almara, ƙwaya, da sauran ƙwayoyin itace. Mashahurin wainar ba da daɗewa ba haɗe biyu tare da kofi mai ƙarfi.
translations.reference: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.hypothesis: Many German-style beers are also dark in color and have hints of malt, hops, and other grains. The popular beer is usually served in tall, slender glasses.

translations.source: Idan kuna son ɗan ƙaramin abincimai ɗanɗano, gwada abin da ya dogara da yankin da ake kira Berliner, Pfannkuchen ko Krapfen.
translations.reference: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: If you are in the mood for a small snack, try the local Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.

translations.source: Curry abinci ne da ta samu asali daga ganyen itace da kayan kamshi, tare da nama ko kayan lambu.
translations.reference: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.hypothesis: A curry is a dish that has evolved from a combination of aromatic herbs and spices, with or without meat or vegetables.

translations.source: Kori na iya kasancewa “busasshe” ko “mai ruwa” abinda ya danganta da yawan ruwan da ke jikinsa.
translations.reference: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.hypothesis: Lesions may be “dry” or “wet” depending on the amount of fluid they contain.

translations.source: A cikin yankuna masu nisa na Arewacin Indiya da Pakistan, ana amfani da madala a cikin curry; a Kudancin Indiya da wasu yankuna na gabar teku na yankin, ana amfani da madarar kwakwa sosai.
translations.reference: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.hypothesis: In the far north of India and Pakistan, yoghurt is used in curries; in the south of India and other coastal areas, coconut milk is used extensively.

translations.source: Tare da tsibirai 17,000 da za a zaɓa daga ciki, abincin Indonesiya laima ce da ke rufe yawancin nau'ikan abinci na yanki da aka samo a duk faɗin ƙasar.
translations.reference: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.hypothesis: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian cuisine is a melting pot of regional specialties drawn from across the archipelago.

translations.source: Amma, idan aka yi amfani da shi ba tare da ƙarin ƙwarewar ba, kalmar tana nufin ma'anar abinci asali daga ɓangarorin tsakiya da gabashin babban tsibirin Java.
translations.reference: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.hypothesis: However, when used without additional context, the term usually refers to the original cuisine from the central and eastern parts of the island of Java.

translations.source: Yanzu ana samu a faɗin rukunin tsibiran, jerin nau’ikan abincin yan Java, yawancin kayan kamshin da su ka fi sakawa shine na gyada, yaji da sukari (musamman sukarin kwakwa) da kuma wasu kayan kanshin.
translations.reference: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.hypothesis: Now found throughout the islands, the cuisine of the Javanese archipelago is a complex tapestry of flavours, with a heavy emphasis on rice, peanuts, soy, coconut milk, palm sugar and a complex array of spices.

translations.source: Likkafa tallafi ne ga ƙafafun mahayi waɗanda su ke rataye a kowane ɓangaren sirdi.
translations.reference: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.hypothesis: Dialysis is a life support treatment for people with kidney failure.

translations.source: Su na ba da daidaito ga matuki sai dai akwai damuwa dangane hadarin kafar matukin na iya makalewa a jiki.
translations.reference: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.hypothesis: They offer a degree of protection to the rider but there are concerns about the risk of the scooter rider being injured in a collision.

translations.source: Idan mai hawan doki ya faɗi daga kan doki amma ƙafarsa tana jikin matakalar, za a iya jan su idan dokin ya gudu. Domin rage wanna hatsarin, za a iya ɗaukan matakan kariya da dama.
translations.reference: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.hypothesis: If a skater falls off the skates but keeps his/her balance, he/she can be dragged by the skates if they move. To reduce this risk, several safety measures can be taken.

translations.source: Da farko, yawancin mahaya suna sanye da takalman hawa masu diddige da kuma ƙasan takalmi mai santsi, matsattse.
translations.reference: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.hypothesis: First, most riders wear helmets and have shoes with a good grip, and balance.

translations.source: Na gaba, wasu siddi, mussamman siddin Ingila, na dauke da kariya dake barin fata ya fita daga siddin yayin da mai hawa ya janyo shi baya gabanin fadowa.
translations.reference: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.hypothesis: The next, some saddles, especially English saddles, have a flap that hangs down on one side, allowing the rider to move his legs forward and down in front of the horse's shoulders.

translations.source: Kwarin Cochamó - shine wajen hawan dutse mafi fice da ake zuwa wanda aka sani da Yosemite na Kudancin Amurka, wanda ke da manyan katangu na dutse daban-daban da matakaloli na dutse masu tsawo.
translations.reference: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.hypothesis: The Cochamó Valley - is the most outstanding climbing destination in South America, with a huge variety of rock types and long, steep rock faces.

translations.source: Taron na hada da raayi na jamaa da sama. Mutane daga sassa daban-daban na duniya sun ci gaba da samar da sababin hanyoyi tsakanin yawancin albarkun mara karewar ganuwan.
translations.reference: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.hypothesis: The Summit is a people-powered movement. People from all walks of life around the world are innovating new solutions among many other overlooked resources.

translations.source: Wasannin dusar kankara na gangaren tudu, wanda ya kunshi gudun ƙanƙara da allon zarmiya, sanannun wasanni ne da suka hada da surmiyowa ta kan yankin da dusar ƙanƙara ta rufe da takalman gudun ƙanƙara ko allon zarmiya a ɗaure da kafafunka.
translations.reference: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.hypothesis: Ice skating, which involves running on ice with ice skates, is a popular sport that consists of running on a frozen surface with ice skates attached to your feet.

translations.source: Wasa kan dusar kankara wasa ne na masu tafiye-tafiye da masun goyon baya da yawa, a wasu lokatai an san shi da “ski bums,” suna tsara dukkan hutu ga wasa kan dusan kankara a wani wuri na musamman.
translations.reference: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.hypothesis: Backcountry skiing is a backcountry sport with a high degree of self-sufficiency, sometimes referred to as "ski bumming", that involves planning a trip around skiing in a particular area.

translations.source: Wasan dusar kankara ya dade da farawa -- an samu zanen kogo mai nuna masu wasan tun shakarar 5000 BC!
translations.reference: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: The sport of skiing has ancient roots -- there are cave paintings depicting people skiing dating from 5000 B.C.!

translations.source: Tseren kankara na tsauni an fara shi tun wajajen karni na 17 kuma a shekarar 1861 aka fara gina kulob din masu wannan tsere wanda yan kasar Norway su ka kafa a kasar Australiya.
translations.reference: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.hypothesis: The sport of rock climbing began in the late 19th century and in 1861 the pioneering mountaineering club was founded by Austrians.

translations.source: Daukar jaka a baya don ski: Ana kiran wannan shirin backcountry ski, yawon wasan dusar kankara ko tafiyan wasan dusar kankara.
translations.reference: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.hypothesis: Backcountry skiing: This is also called off-piste skiing, ski touring or ski mountaineering.

translations.source: Yana da alaƙa da amma yawanci ba sa ƙunshi salon tsalle-tsalle ko hawa dutse, na ƙarshen waɗanda aka yi a cikin ƙasa mai tsayi kuma suna buƙatar madaukakan skis da takalma.
translations.reference: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.hypothesis: They are related to but generally not as steep or rocky, the latter requiring special long skis and boots.

translations.source: Yi la’akari da hanyar wasan dussar kankara tamkar hanyar tafiya.
translations.reference: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.hypothesis: Think of the blockchain as a ledger.

translations.source: A cikin yanayi mai kyau zaku iya yin tafiya mai nisa fiye da takawa da ƙafa – amma ba kasafai ake samun saurin gudu kan kankara ba tare da jakar goyawa a baya mai nauyi a kan hanyar da aka share ƙanƙara.
translations.reference: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.hypothesis: In good conditions you can go farther on a bike than on foot—but it is seldom possible to go fast on a bicycle on a trail littered with roots and rocks.

translations.source: Turai nahiya ce karama amma cike da kasashe masu yancin kansu. A tsari ana iya cewa yin tafiye-tafiye tsakanin kasashen na nufin sai ka nemi takardun izinin shiga da ratsa wuraren binciken takardun tafiya.
translations.reference: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.hypothesis: Europe is a relatively small continent, but it is made up of many independent countries. In general, you can say that traveling between countries means you have to ask for permission to enter and cross the borders.

translations.source: Yankin Schengen, duk da haka, yana aiki kamar ƙasa ɗaya ta wannan.
translations.reference: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.hypothesis: The Schengen Area, however, functions as a single country in this regard.

translations.source: Muddin ka tsaya a wannan yankin, gabaɗaya zaka iya ƙetare iyakoki ba tare da wucewa cikin wuraren kula da fasfon ba.
translations.reference: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.hypothesis: If you stay in this area, you can usually cross the border without any problems, as long as you do not go through the official border crossing.

translations.source: Hakanan, samun izinin shiga kasashen Schengen, ya sa baka bukatar samun izinin daidaikun kasashe da ke cikin jerin kasashen, hakan na rage asarar lokaci, kudi da cike ciken takardu.
translations.reference: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.hypothesis: Also, obtaining a Schengen visa allows you to enter all the countries in the zone without applying for individual visas, saving you time, money, and paperwork.

translations.source: Babu wani ma'anar duniya wanda kayan masana'antu sune kayan tarihi. Wasu hukumomin haraji sun ayyana kayan da suka girmi shekaru 100 a matsayin kayan tarihi.
translations.reference: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.hypothesis: There is no universal definition of what constitutes an antique. Some tax authorities define an antique as an item that is 100 years old.

translations.source: Ma’anar na da banbancin yanki, inda iyakar shekaru ke iya kasancewa kaɗan a wurare kamar Amurika ta Arewa fiye da ƙsashen Turai.
translations.reference: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.hypothesis: The meaning is culturally specific, with age cut-offs varying by as much as 20 years in some countries (e.g. North America) compared with others (e.g. Europe).

translations.source: Za'a iya ma'anar kayayyakin aikin hannu azaman tsoffin kayayyakin tarihi, dukda cewa sunfi saurayi irin kayan da aka girka.
translations.reference: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.hypothesis: Artifacts can be defined as any historic object, though the term most often refers to manufactured objects.

translations.source: Kiwon dabbar Reindeer wani gata mai muhimmanci ne tsakanin ƴan Sámi kuma al'adar a kewayar sana'ar tana da muhimmanci kuma wajen yawanci da suke da wasu sana'o'i.
translations.reference: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.hypothesis: Reindeer herding is an important part of the Sami culture and a way of life for many of them.

translations.source: Ko a al'adance, duk da cewa, ba duk dan Sami bane suka tsunduma cikin harkar kiwo mai yawa, amma sun rayu ne daga kamun kifi, farauta da makamantansu, wadanda suke da dabbobin doki akasarinsu dabbobi.
translations.reference: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.hypothesis: Although traditionally not all Sami have been involved in reindeer herding, but rather lived off fishing, fowling and gathering, the reindeer herding Sami are the only indigenous people in Europe with their own language and culture.

translations.source: A yau yawancin Sámi suna yin sana'o'in zamani. Yawon buda ido muhimmin kudin shiga ne a cikin Sámi, yankin na Sámi.
translations.reference: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.hypothesis: Most Sámi people today work in modern industries. Tourism is an important source of income in the Sami region.

translations.source: Kodayake ana amfani da shi ko'ina, musamman tsakanin waɗanda ba Romani ba, kalmar “Gypsy” galibi ana ɗaukarta abin ƙyama ne saboda ƙungiyoyinta da ra'ayoyi marasa kyau da ra'ayoyi marasa kyau game da mutanen Romani.
translations.reference: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.hypothesis: Although it is used ubiquitously, especially among non-Roma, the word "Gypsy" is often considered pejorative due to its association with negative stereotypes and prejudices against Roma people.

translations.source: Idan ƙasar da za ka ziyarta ta zama cikin wadanda sai an nemi shawarar masana, inshorar lafiyarka da ta ikon soke tafiya na iya shafuwa.
translations.reference: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.hypothesis: If your destination is in a country that requires specialist medical advice, your health insurance and travel insurance may be affected.

translations.source: Akwai bukatar neman shawarwari daga wasu gwamnatocin ba gwamnatin ka kawai ba, amma dai shawarwarinsu an tsara su ne domin yan kasar su.
translations.reference: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.hypothesis: Advice needs to be sought from governments outside your own, but their advice is unlikely to be tailored to your specific circumstances.

translations.source: A misali ɗaya, ‘yan ƙasar Amurka da ke Gabas ta Tsakiya su na iya fuskantar halaye daban daga Turawa ko Larabawa.
translations.reference: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.hypothesis: For example, Americans in the Middle East may behave differently from Europeans or Arabs.

translations.source: Shawara kawai takaitaccen bayani ne game da yanayin siyasar wata kasa.
translations.reference: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.hypothesis: The advice is just a brief overview of a country's political climate.

translations.source: Ra’ayoyin da aka gabatar galibi na gaggawa ne, na gaba daya kuma marar zurfin tunani idan aka kwatanta su da cikakken bayanin da ake samu a wani wuri.
translations.reference: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.hypothesis: The views expressed are generally more immediate, emotional and less considered than those in a newspaper editorial.

translations.source: Mummunan yanayi kalma ce ga duk wani yanayi mai hatsari tare da yiwuwar haifar da lalacewa, rikicewar zamantakewar jama'a, ko asarar rayuwar ɗan adam.
translations.reference: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.hypothesis: An emergency situation is a dangerous situation with the potential to cause harm, social disruption, or loss of life.

translations.source: Yanayi mai tsanani na iya aukuwa a ko wani bangare na duniya kuma sun bambanta, kuma sun dogara ne ga yanayin kasa da taswirar kasa da kuma ka’idojin iskar shaka.
translations.reference: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.hypothesis: Extreme temperatures can occur anywhere in the world and are highly variable, depending on the local climate and the region's latitude and altitude.

translations.source: Babban iska, ƙanƙara, hazo mai yawa, da gobarar daji siffofi ne da tasirin mummunan yanayi, haka ma hadari, guguwa, kogin ruwa, da mahaukaciyar guguwa.
translations.reference: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.hypothesis: Heatwaves, droughts, cyclones, floods, landslides, wildfires, tsunamis, volcanic eruptions and earthquakes are all extreme climate events.

translations.source: Aukuwar tsananin yanayin yanki da na lokacin sun hada da guguwar iska, hadari mai dusar kankara, guguwar kankara, da guguwar ƙura.
translations.reference: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.hypothesis: Extreme weather events include tropical cyclones, hurricanes, tornadoes, blizzards, avalanches, and droughts.

translations.source: Ana matuƙar shawartar matafiya da su kasance masu lura da duk wani haɗarin mummunan yanayi wanda zai shafi yankin su domin za su iya shafar duk wani shirin tafiya.
translations.reference: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers should be alert to any potential security risks in their particular area of travel as these can affect any travel plans.

translations.source: Duk wanda ke shirin ziyara zuwa wata ƙasa da za a iya kallonta a zaman fagen yaƙi dole ya samu horon ƙwararru.
translations.reference: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.hypothesis: Anyone planning to visit a country considered a high-risk area should seek professional medical advice.

translations.source: Binciken yanar gizo don ‘yanayin muhalli mai tsanani’ yana iya fitar adireshin wani kamfanin gargajiya.
translations.reference: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.hypothesis: A web search for "severe environmental pollution" might bring up the address of a local factory.

translations.source: Hanya koyaushe za ta rufe dukkan batutuwan da aka tattauna a nan cikin mafi cikakken bayani, yawanci tare da ƙwarewar aiki.
translations.reference: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.hypothesis: The approach usually covers all topics discussed in the course in greater detail, often with practical experience.

translations.source: Wani kwas wanda za a yi cikin kwana 2-5 wanda zai shafi aikin da ya kunshi horarwa kan agajin gaggawa da kuma a wasu lokutan har da horarwa na makamai.
translations.reference: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.hypothesis: A 2-5 day course that involves practical sessions and sometimes even weapon-based training.

translations.source: Littattafai da mujallu masu ma'amala da rayuwar jeji sanannu ne, amma wallafe-wallafen da ke magana game da yankunan yaƙi ba su da yawa.
translations.reference: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.hypothesis: Books and magazines about outdoor living are common, but publications specifically about hiking are less common.

translations.source: dole sai matafiya masu kokarin yin tiyatar canza jinsi sun tabbatar suna dauke da ingantattun takardun tafiyar komawa gida.
translations.reference: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.hypothesis: transgender travelers should ensure they have appropriate documentation to support their gender identity.

translations.source: Kaunar gwamnatoci don bayar da fasfo ɗin da jinsi ba a bayyana ba (X) ko takaddun da aka sabunta don daidaita sunan da ake so kuma jinsi ya bambanta.
translations.reference: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.hypothesis: The advocacy for governments to introduce gender-neutral (X) passports or updated identity documents to accurately reflect an individual's chosen name and gender identity.

translations.source: Kasancewar yardar gwamnatocin kasashen waje don girmama waɗannan takardu yana da saurin canzawa.
translations.reference: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.hypothesis: The degree to which foreign governments will accept these documents is unknown.

translations.source: Bincike a wuraren bincike na jami’an tsaro su ma sun zama da karin shishigi bayan zamanin Satumba 11, 2001.
translations.reference: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.hypothesis: Screenings at border security checkpoints have also increased since September 11, 2001.

translations.source: kada mutanen da suka sauya jinsinsu su yi tsammanin za su iya wuce wa ta gaban na’urorin haska hoton jiki ba tare da fallasar sirri da mutuncinsu ba.
translations.reference: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.hypothesis: Transgender people should not have to risk their safety and dignity to access medical care.

translations.source: Igiyar ruwa mai yagawa su ne ruwa ne mai dawowa daga raƙuman ruwa da ke fasa rairayin bakin teku.
translations.reference: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.hypothesis: Tidal currents are water currents produced by the movement of the tides.

translations.source: Saboda yanayin karkashin ruwa da ke sa gudana da mai da hankali a wurare masu zurfi, sannan igiyar ruwa mafi zurfi na iya haduwa a wurin.
translations.reference: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.hypothesis: Because of the way the bottom of the ocean is so deep, the pressure down there is a lot.

translations.source: Yawancin mace-mace suna faruwa ne sakamakon gajiya da ke ƙoƙari ya koma baya kan na yanzu, wanda ƙila ba zai yiwu ba.
translations.reference: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the deaths are due to complications arising from pregnancies that could have been easily managed in a properly equipped and staffed facility.

translations.source: Da zarar ka fita daga ruwan, sake komawa ruwan ba zai zo da wata sarkakiya ba.
translations.reference: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.hypothesis: Once you're out of the water, getting back in is not a big deal.

translations.source: Yi ƙoƙarin auna wani wuri inda ba za a sake samun ka ba ko kuma, ya danganta da ƙwarewarka da kuma cewa ko an gan ka, watakila za ka so jiran ceto.
translations.reference: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.hypothesis: Try to assess the situation and if you are not able to find a solution or, depending on your experience and the situation, maybe it's best to wait for rescue.

translations.source: Kaɗuwar sake-shiga za ta yi saurin zuwa kafin kaɗuwar al’adu (akwai karancin lokaci na hutun amarci), ya dade, kuma izai ya zama da tsanani sosai.
translations.reference: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.hypothesis: The return migration is often faster, more visible (more short-term visitors), and can be more disruptive.

translations.source: Matafiya waɗanda ke da sauƙin sauƙaƙawa zuwa sabon al'adun a wasu lokuta suna da matukar wahalar gyara al'adunsu na asali.
translations.reference: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.hypothesis: Travellers who adapt easily to a new culture sometimes have a hard time readjusting to their original culture.

translations.source: Lokacin dawowa gida bayan zama a ƙasashen waje, kun saba da sabon al'adun kuma kun rasa wasu al'adunku daga al'adunku na gida.
translations.reference: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.hypothesis: When you go back home after living in a foreign country for a while, you get used to a new culture and miss some of your old cultural values from your homeland.

translations.source: Kasancewa a kasar waje a karo na farko, na sa matafiya yin hakuri da nuna fahimta, saboda sanin cewa matafiya na bukatar hakan domin su saba da wajen.
translations.reference: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.hypothesis: Being in a foreign country for the first time can be exciting, but also a little overwhelming, and it's important to be patient and understanding of the need for visitors to acclimatise.

translations.source: Ba lallai Mutane su fahimci cewa yin haƙuri da nuna fahimta wajibi ne ga matafiya da ke kokarin komawa gida.
translations.reference: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.hypothesis: People should understand that patience and understanding are necessary for travelers trying to get home.

translations.source: Sautin dala da wasan haske na daya daga cikin abubuwa masu dadi a fanni kananan yara.
translations.reference: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.hypothesis: The dollar sound and the cartoon characters are some of the fun things about this platform.

translations.source: Za ka iya ganin dalar a cikin duhu kuma za ka iya ganin su a tsanake kafin shirin ya fara.
translations.reference: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.hypothesis: You can see the dollar in the dark and you can see them again before the show.

translations.source: Yawanci kodayaushe ka kan ji sautin ‘yan yawon shakatawa da masu talla. Labarin sauti da hasken to kawai kamar littafin labari ne.
translations.reference: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.hypothesis: You'll often hear the sounds of tourists and hawkers. The light and sound show is just like a regular show.

translations.source: An yi amfani da sassaken zaki na Egypt a matsayin jigo wajen bada dogon labari.
translations.reference: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.hypothesis: Egyptian hieroglyphs were used as a basis for the Rosetta Stone.

translations.source: Ana nuna wuraren akan dalar kuma an haskaka dalolin mabambanta.
translations.reference: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.hypothesis: The spots are shown in US dollars and the different denominations are highlighted.

translations.source: Tsibirin Kudancin Shetland, wanda aka gano a cikin 1819, kasashe da yawa suna da'awar su kuma suna da mafi yawan tushe, tare da goma sha shida suna aiki a 2020.
translations.reference: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.hypothesis: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several countries and have a number of bases, with sixteen operating in 2020.

translations.source: Tsibirin na kwanciye 120 km arewa da sashin kasa mai shiga teku. Mafi girma shine King George Island mai dauke da mazauna na Villa Estrellas.
translations.reference: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: The islands are located 120 km (75 mi) north of the Antarctic Peninsula. The largest is King George Island which contains the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.

translations.source: Sauran sun hada da Livingston Island, da Yaudarar Inda ambaliyar caldera na har dutsen mai fitad da wuta yana ba da tashar jiragen ruwa na halitta.
translations.reference: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.hypothesis: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception Island, where the flooded caldera of an active volcano provides a natural harbour.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land shine yanki na kudu da masarautar, da Tekun Bellingshausen ya daure.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.hypothesis: The Ellsworth Land is the area south of the Queen Maud Land, and is limited to the west by the Bellingshausen Sea.

translations.source: Tsaunukan da ke nan wurin a Tsibirin sun haɗe da yankin mai tudu, sannan suka sake bulla a gaba inda suka haifar da jerin carbin Tsaunukan Elsworth na tsawon kilomita 360, wanda dunkulen Ƙanƙarar Minnesota ya ratsa ta tsakiyarsu.
translations.reference: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: The moraines that make up the Ridges and Lakes Region were formed by the advance of a glacier, and later by the retreat of the 360-kilometer (220 mi) long Ellsworth Moraine, which left a series of lakes in its wake.

translations.source: Yankin arewacin ko Sentinel Range yana da tsaunukan tsaunuka mafi girma na Antarctica, Vinson Massif, wanda yake hawa sama a tsaunin 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: The northernmost part of the Peninsula, and the northernmost point of mainland Antarctica, is Cape North, on the base of the Antarctic Peninsula.

translations.source: A wurare masu nisa, idan babu sabis na wayar salula, wayar tauraron dan adam na iya zama zaɓin ku kaɗai.
translations.reference: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.hypothesis: In remote areas without a cellular service, a satellite phone may be your only option.

translations.source: Wayar tauraron dan adam a gaba daya ba za ta maye gurbin wayar hannu ba, domin sai kun kasance a waje tare da yin saiti da tauraron dan adam don yin kiran da wayar.
translations.reference: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.hypothesis: Satellite phones are not a replacement for mobile phones, as you have to be outdoors with a clear view of the sky to make a call.

translations.source: Ana amfani sosai da aikin a harkokin sufurin ruwa, wanda ya hada da jiragen shakatawa da masu bincike da ke bukatar sadarwa a lungu ko bukatar muryoyi.
translations.reference: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.hypothesis: The service is also used by commercial shipping, including cruise ships and freighters, that need to communicate over long distances or require voice communications.

translations.source: Yakamata kamfanin wayar tarho na yankin ku ya kasance zai iya bada ƙarin bayani game da yin haɗi da wannan sabis ɗin.
translations.reference: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.hypothesis: Your local mobile network operator should be able to provide more information on how to connect to the service.

translations.source: Wani zaɓi da ya ke kara samun karbuwa ga waɗanda ke shirin ratar-shekara shine yin tafiya don sani.
translations.reference: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.hypothesis: Another increasingly popular option for those planning a year out is to take a gap year.

translations.source: Wannan ya shahara musamman ga masu tsallake-tsallake a makaranta, suna basu damar ɗaukar shekara guda kafin jami'a, ba tare da lalata karatunsu ba.
translations.reference: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.hypothesis: This is particularly advantageous for students in diploma-awarding institutions, as it allows them to gain a year of university credit without disrupting their current course of study.

translations.source: A lokuta da dama shiga/fara kwas na ratan shekara guda a ketare zai iya inganta damammakinka na kara nosawa gaba a karatu idan ka dawo kasar haihuwarka.
translations.reference: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.hypothesis: In many cases, an exchange year can improve your career opportunities when you return to your home country.

translations.source: Yawanci za a sami kuɗin karatun shiga don shiga cikin waɗannan shirye-shiryen ilimin.
translations.reference: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.hypothesis: There are usually entrance fees to cover the costs of running these programmes.

translations.source: Finland babban wurin zuwan kwalekwale ne. “Ƙasa mai tafkuna dubu” tana kuma da dubban tsibirai, a cikin tafkuna da kuma cikin rukunin tsibirai.
translations.reference: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.hypothesis: Finland is a world-class archipelago. The "Land of a Thousand Lakes" also has as many islands, in lakes and in the sea.

translations.source: A yankunan masu tsibirai barjak da tafkuna ba lallaia bukaci kanana jiragen ruwaba.
translations.reference: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.hypothesis: In island areas and archipelagos, small boats are often the only means of transport.

translations.source: Kodayake tarin tsibirai na bakin teku da manyan tabkuna suna da girman isa ga kowane jirgin ruwa, ƙananan jiragen ruwa ko ma kayak suna ba da kwarewa daban.
translations.reference: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.hypothesis: While the main islands and larger bays are accessible to larger cruise ships, smaller ships or kayaks provide access to more remote areas.

translations.source: Jirgin ruwa jirgi ne na kasar Finland, tare da kwale-kwale ga kowane mutum bakwai ko takwas.
translations.reference: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.hypothesis: The ship is a Finnish-designed ice-strengthened expedition cruise ship, with space for 7 or 8 people.

translations.source: Wannan ya dace da Norway, Sweden da New Zealand, amma in ba haka ba ya zama na musamman (misali a cikin Netherlands adadi ɗaya ne zuwa arba'in).
translations.reference: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.hypothesis: This is true for Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but less so for others (in the Netherlands the number is one in forty).

translations.source: Yawancin sanannun Baltic Cruises sun ƙunshi karin tsawan zama a St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Most popular Baltic Sea cruises include an overnight stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.

translations.source: Wannan na nuna cewa kana iya ziyartar birni mai tarihi na kwanaki da dama yayin da ake dawowa ko yin bacci a cikin jirgin ruwan da dare.
translations.reference: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.hypothesis: This means you can take a multi-day trip to a historic city while sleeping in a ship at night.

translations.source: Idan ka hau ruwa ta amfani da yawon bude ido a jirgin ruwa ba za ka buƙaci biza ta daban ba (kamar daga 2009).
translations.reference: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.hypothesis: If you arrive by boat as a tourist you do not need a separate visa (as of 2009).

translations.source: Wasu jiragen ruwa su kan sanya Berlin, Jamus a cikin littafin bayanin. Kamar yadda ka ke gani daga taswirar da ke sama babu inda Berlin ta yi kusa da teku kuma ba a haɗa ziyarar birnin ba a farashin jirgi.
translations.reference: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.hypothesis: Some flights list Berlin, Germany as a destination. As you can see from the map above, Berlin is nowhere near the sea and a visit to the city is not part of a cruise fare.

translations.source: Tafiya ta hanyar jirgin sama kan iya zama abu mai firgitarwa ga mutane a duk rukunin shekaru da asali, musamman idan ba su taɓa hawa jirgi ba ko kuma sun taɓa shiga al’amari mai firgitarwa.
translations.reference: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.hypothesis: Flying can be a nerve-wracking experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, especially for those who have never been on a plane or have had a negative experience in the past.

translations.source: Ba abun jin kunya bane: bata sha bambam da tsoro da kuma rashin kaunar abubuwan da yawancin mutane ke dashi.
translations.reference: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.hypothesis: It is not uncommon: it is similar to other widely accepted and encouraged human activities such as sports and arts.

translations.source: Ga wasu, fahimtar yadda jirgi yake aiki da kuma ko mene ne ke faruwa yayin da jirgin yake tafiya watakila ya taimaka wajen shawo kan fargabar da tushenta ba a ma san shi ba ko kuma ma ba a iya shawo kansa.
translations.reference: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.hypothesis: For some, understanding how a flight works and what causes the sensations they experience during flight may help them to manage their fear and anxiety.

translations.source: A na biyan kamfanonin aika saƙonni sosai don isar da abubuwa da sauri. Akai-akai, lokaci yana da matukar mahimmanci game da takardun kasuwanci, abin sayarwa ko kayan gyara don gyara na gaggawa.
translations.reference: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.hypothesis: The SMS provider is paid a small fee for each delivery. Often, time is of the essence with commercial paper, bills for urgent repairs, or other time-sensitive materials.

translations.source: A wasu hanyoyin, manyan kanfanonin na da jiragen samansu, amma a wasu hanyoyi daban da ƙananan kanfanoni akwai matsala.
translations.reference: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.hypothesis: In some cases, the major players have their own aircraft, but for most other companies, it is a logistical nightmare.

translations.source: Idan sun aika da kaya ta hanyar jigilar jirgin sama, akan wasu hanyoyi ya zama ya dauki kwanaki kafin a ya tsallake saukewa na ‘yan kwastam.
translations.reference: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.hypothesis: If they ship via air freight, it usually takes a few days to go through customs.

translations.source: Hanya kaɗai mafi saurin wucewarsu shine ta hanyar tura su a matsayin jakunkunan da aka duba. Tsarin dokokin kamfunan zirga-zirgar jiragen sama ba ya bada damar tura jaka ba tare da mai ita zai yi tafiya ba, to anan ne inda za ka shigo.
translations.reference: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.hypothesis: The only way to get them is by sending them as checked baggage. Airline regulations do not permit the carriage of lithium batteries on passenger flights, so here’s where you come in.

translations.source: Sananniyar hanya ta tashi a ajin farko ko ajin kasuwanci na jirgin sama shine ka fito da damin kudi domin gata (ko, mafi kyau tukuna, ka sanya kamfaninka su yi maka).
translations.reference: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.hypothesis: The typical way to get a First Class or Business Class ticket is to spend the money to buy it (or, more precisely, to let your company spend the money on your behalf).

translations.source: Sai dai hakan ba ya samuwa cikin sauƙi: a matsayin ƙa’idar ana tsammanin ka biya ribi hudu na ajin marasa ƙarfi kuma ribi goma sha daya na ajin masu wadataa
translations.reference: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.hypothesis: But it is not free; you are expected to pay four times more as a low-income earner and eleven times more if you are a high-income earner.

translations.source: A gabaɗaya, babu ma'ana a cikin koda neman ragi don kasuwanci ko kujerun ajin farko a kan jiragen sama kai tsaye daga A zuwa B.
translations.reference: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.hypothesis: In general, it does not make sense to book a round-the-world ticket or a first class ticket from A to B directly.

translations.source: Kamfanonin jiragen sama sun sani sarai cewa akwai wasu rukuni na rukuni na wasiƙa waɗanda suke shirye su biya dala mafi girma don alfarmar zuwa wani wuri cikin sauri da jin daɗi, kuma su biya hakan.
translations.reference: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.hypothesis: Airlines know that there are certain groups of people willing to pay a premium for the convenience of flying direct and non-stop, and they cater to them.

translations.source: Babban birnin Moldova shi ne Chişinău. yaren cikin gida shi ne Romaniyanci, amma ana amfani da harshen Rasha sosai.
translations.reference: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.hypothesis: The capital of Moldova is Chișinău. The official language is Romanian, but Russian is widely spoken.

translations.source: Maldova jamhuriya ce mai kabilu da dama da ta yi fama da rikicin kabilanci.
translations.reference: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has experienced ethnic tensions.

translations.source: A shekarar 1994, wannan rikici ya haifar da kirkirar da kanta mai ikirarin Jamhuriyyar Transnistria a gabashin Moldova, wacce ke da gwamnatinta da kudin ta amma ba wata kungiyar mambobin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta amince da shi ba.
translations.reference: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.hypothesis: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the unrecognized Republic of Transnistria in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognized by any UN member state.

translations.source: An maido da harkar cinikayya tsakanin bangarori biyu na Maldova duk da rushewar tattaunawar siyasa.
translations.reference: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.hypothesis: Trade between the two Moldovan regions has reportedly resumed despite the political discussions.

translations.source: Babban addini a Moldova shine Kiristocin aqidah.
translations.reference: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.hypothesis: The predominant religion in Moldova is Christianity.

translations.source: Izmir shi ne birni na uku mafi girma a Turkiyya da yawan jama’a kimanin miliyan 3.7, kuma tashar jiragen ruwa ta biyu mafi girma bayan ta Istanbul, kuma babbar cibiyar sufuri.
translations.reference: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.hypothesis: İzmir is Turkey's third-largest city with a population of around 3.7 million, and its second-largest port after Istanbul, and a major industrial center.

translations.source: A da yana a matsayin tsohon birnin Smyrna, yanzu cibiyar hada-hadar kasuwanci ce ta zamani, da ta bnƙasa, da ta ke zagayen wani ƙaton mashigin ruwa sannan kuma yana zagaye da duwatsu.
translations.reference: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.hypothesis: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern commercial centre, built on a small bay and surrounded by hills.

translations.source: Manya-manyan tituna, gidajen gilashi da manyan kantunan siyayya an kawata su da jajayen rufi na gargajiya, kasuwa ta karni na 18, da wani tsohon masallaci da coci, koda yake dai garin ya fi kama da irin na turai da ke gabar bahar rum fiye da ace garin gargajiya ne a kasar Turkiya.
translations.reference: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.hypothesis: The main streets, with their traditional red-tiled roofs, 18th-century marketplace and old mosque and church, give the town a unique character, though the overall atmosphere is more European than genuinely Turkish.

translations.source: Kauyen Haldarsvík yana ba da damar kallon tsibirin Eysturoy da ke kusa kuma yana da wata cocin mai kusurwa takwas wadda ba saba ganin irin ta ba.
translations.reference: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.hypothesis: The village of Haldarsvík offers a view of the island of Eysturoy and is home to an unusual eight-sided church.

translations.source: A cikin farfajiyar majami'ar, akwai zane-zanen marmara mai ban sha'awa na kurciya akan wasu kaburburan.
translations.reference: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.hypothesis: In the cemetery, there are interesting ice sculptures on some of the graves.

translations.source: Shafe rabin sa’a na tattaki a cikin shu’umin ƙauyen ya biya.
translations.reference: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.hypothesis: Half an hour's walk through the village brings you to the falls.

translations.source: Ta gefen arewa mai saukin shiga nan ne Birnin Sintra ya ke wanda ya shahara ga yan kasashen waje bayan da Lord Byron ya bada kayatattun labaran kyawonta.
translations.reference: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Just north of the easily accessible city of Sintra are Pena Castle and the Moorish Castle, the latter offering a good view of the former.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 na yin tafiya sosai zuwa Sintra, tare da dakatawa a Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: The Scotturb Bus 403 makes regular trips to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Hakanan zuwa arewa ziyarci babban Wuri Mai Tsarki na Uwargidanmu Fatima (Shrine), wuri ne na shahararrun bayyanar Marian a duniya.
translations.reference: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.hypothesis: Also in the north is the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima, a world-renowned Marian pilgrimage site.

translations.source: Da fatan za a tuna cewa da gaske ana ziyartar babban kabari ne, kazalika da shafin da ke da kusan ma'ana ga yawancin ɓangarorin duniya.
translations.reference: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.hypothesis: Please note that this is a cemetery and a memorial site with significance to many parts of the world.

translations.source: Har yanzu akwai maza da mata da yawa da ke raye waɗanda suka rayu lokacinsu a nan, kuma da yawa da yawa waɗanda suke da ƙaunatattunsu waɗanda aka kashe ko suka yi aiki zuwa can, yahudawa da waɗanda ba Yahudawa ba.
translations.reference: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.hypothesis: There are still many survivors alive, and many more who have loved ones who were killed or worked in the camps, Jewish and non-Jewish.

translations.source: Da fatan za a kula da rukunin yanar gizon tare da dukkan mutunci, girmamawa da girmama shi. Kada ku yi ba'a game da fitinar Holocaust ko Nazis.
translations.reference: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.hypothesis: Please treat the website with all due respect, courtesy and decorum. Do not make light of the Holocaust or Nazis.

translations.source: Kada ku lalata wurin ginin ta hanyar sa alamar ko kuma nuna alamar rubutu a cikin ginin.
translations.reference: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.hypothesis: Do not damage the building by carving or otherwise marking the building.

translations.source: Harsunan Barcelona na yau da kullun sune Catalan da Spanish. Kimanin rabin sun fi son yin magana da Catalan, yawancinsu sun fahimce shi, kuma kusan kowa ya san Sifen.
translations.reference: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.hypothesis: The official languages of Barcelona are Catalan and Spanish. About half the population claim to be native speakers of Catalan, most of them understand Spanish, and almost everyone knows a bit of English.

translations.source: Ko da yake, ana nuna galibin alamomin ana nuna su Katalanci sakamakon bisa doka shi ne yaren hukumana farko.
translations.reference: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.hypothesis: However, the symptoms are often attributed to other causes because the condition is culturally and linguistically determined.

translations.source: Duk da haka, ana kuma amfani da harshen Spanish sosai a harkar sufuri na jama’a da wasu wurare.
translations.reference: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.hypothesis: However, Spanish is also the language of public transportation and many signs.

translations.source: Ana yin sanarwar yau da gobe a jirgin ƙarƙashin ƙasa a Catalan kaɗai, amma na’urar da ke aiki da kanta ce ke sanar da hargitsin da babu shiri a harsuna iri-iri da suka haɗa da Sifaniyanci, Turanci, Faransanci, Larabci da harshen Japan.
translations.reference: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.hypothesis: Today and tomorrow announcements will only be made in Catalan on the metro, but the device which makes the announcements also plays pre-recorded messages in a variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.

translations.source: Mutanen Paris sun yi suna kan son kai, rashin kunya da girman kai.
translations.reference: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.hypothesis: The people of Paris have a reputation for being cynical, rude and arrogant.

translations.source: Yayin da yake wannan yawanci ra’ayi ne wanda ba daidai ba, hanya mafi kyau don yin sabo a cikin Paris har yanzu shine kasancewa kan halayyarka mafi kyau, yin aiki kamar wanda yake “bien élevé” (wanda ya sami tarbiyya mai kyau). Zai sanya yin sabo ya kasance mai sauki.
translations.reference: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.hypothesis: While this is a rather cliché view, the best way to go about getting around in Paris is still to stay on your best behaviour, and act like someone who was "bien élevé" (well-bred). It makes the going much easier.

translations.source: Fuskar mutanen Paris ta bazata za ta yi saurin ɓacewa idan ka nuna wasu halayen girmamawa.
translations.reference: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.hypothesis: The Parisian's face of stone will melt a little if you show some signs of respect.

translations.source: Tafkunan Plitvice na wajen shakatawa yana da wani surkukin daji, galibi da kamannin bishiyoyin fir da na kudan zuma da kuma hadin wanda ya shafi manyan tsaunuka da duwatsu tare da ciyaye na Rum.
translations.reference: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.hypothesis: The Plitvice Lakes National Park has a unique landscape, mostly covered by forests of beech, fir, spruce and pine, with a rich flora and fauna, and a series of 16 terraced lakes, connected by a number of waterfalls.

translations.source: Tana da sanannun dangogin itatuwa iri daban-daban, sabo da jerin yankunan yanayi da ta ke da su, da bayyana nau’ukan ƙasa daban-daban da kuma tuddai masu mataki daban-daban.
translations.reference: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.hypothesis: It has a great diversity of habitats, due to the wide range of climatic conditions and the varied geology and topography.

translations.source: Rukunin muhalli na ga dabbobin daji mabambanta da kuma launukan tsuntsaye.
translations.reference: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.hypothesis: The rainforest is home to a huge variety of animals and birds.

translations.source: Dabbobin daji da ba su da yawa irin su Malu mai launin ruwan kasa da ke turai, kerkeci, mikiya, mujiya, kyanwar daji da kuma capercaillie a na iya samun su a can, tare da nau’ukan gama garin dabbobi masu yawa.
translations.reference: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.hypothesis: The fauna is less varied, though the European bison, elk, roe deer, wild boar, lynx and capercaillie can still be seen, along with a number of other species.

translations.source: Yayin ziyartar gidajen sufaye, an buƙaci mata su sa riguna masu rufe gwiwowinsu kuma su rufe ƙafadunsu, kuma.
translations.reference: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.hypothesis: During house visits, women were required to wear clothing that covered their arms and legs, and their heads had to be covered.

translations.source: Mafi yawancin gidajen ibada suna samar da mayafai ga matan da ba su zo da shiri ba, amma idan ki ka zo da naki, musamman wanda yake da launuka masu haske, za ki sami murmushi daga mai bauta namiji ko mace a ƙofar shiga.
translations.reference: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.hypothesis: Most temples provide saris for visitors who do not have appropriate clothing, but bringing your own, especially a light-coloured one, will be appreciated by the temple staff.

translations.source: A bisa wannan madogara, ana buƙatar maza su sanya wanduna da ke rufe gwiwoyi.
translations.reference: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.hypothesis: Based on this assumption, men are required to wear trousers or skirts.

translations.source: Wannan ma za a iya aro shi daga tarin kayan a mashigar amma ba a wanke tufa bayan kowane mutum guda ya yi amfani da tufar don haka ba za ka/ki ji dadin saka wannan bujen ba. Kala guda zai iyamma dukkanin maza.
translations.reference: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.hypothesis: This can be borrowed from the lobby but is not cleaned after each person who uses it so you may not enjoy using it. One size fits all for men.

translations.source: Babban abincin, kamar na yankuna masu kama da wannan a cikin Bahar Rum, ya dogara ne akan burodi, kayan lambu da nama (musamman alade), kuma yana amfani da man zaitun ko'ina.
translations.reference: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.hypothesis: The main courses, like in the surrounding Balkan countries, are based on bread, vegetables and cheese (especially cow and sheep milk cheese), and use olive oil abundantly.

translations.source: Abincin dare mai sauki musamman ma lokacin bazara, shi ne na Pa amb Oli: Burodi ne da man zaitun da tumatir da kuma duk wani kayan hadin da ya samu kamar cukwui da abincin kifi da dai sauransu.
translations.reference: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.hypothesis: A simple dinner, typical of summer, is Pa amb Oli: a slice of bread with olive oil and tomato, and whatever else he has on hand, such as cheese or anchovies.

translations.source: Dukkan sunaye, wadanda ke da kalmar Sie a ciki, koda yaushe suna farawa ne da babban harafi, koda a tsakiyar jimla ne.
translations.reference: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.hypothesis: All words, which contain the letter "s", are always capitalized, even in the middle of a sentence.

translations.source: Wannan mahimmiyar hanya ce wajen banbance kalmomin aikatau da kalmomi na abubuwa da ake iya gani.
translations.reference: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.hypothesis: This is an important distinction from words that describe physical objects.

translations.source: Hakanan yana iya kawo sauƙin karatu, kodayake rubutu yana da ɗan rikitarwa ta hanyar buƙatar gano ko ana amfani da fi'ili ko sifa a cikin sigar tabbatarwa.
translations.reference: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.hypothesis: It can also make reading easier, although the text is slightly more complex because it requires the reader to identify the active or passive voice in each sentence.

translations.source: Furuci yana da ɗan sauƙi a cikin Italiyanci tunda yawancin kalmomi ana furta daidai yadda ake rubuta suu
translations.reference: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.hypothesis: Italian is a relatively easy language to pronounce because most words are pronounced as they are written.

translations.source: Manyan haruffan da ya kamata a lura da su a nan sune c da g, kasancewar furucinsu ya banbamta daga wannan wasalin da ke biye.
translations.reference: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.hypothesis: The only letters to be concerned about here are c and g, because their pronunciation varies in this context.

translations.source: Hakanan, tabbatar da furta r da rr daban: caro yana nufin ƙaunata, yayin da karas yana nufin karusa.
translations.reference: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.hypothesis: Also, be careful to pronounce the single and double "r" sounds distinctly: "caro" means "dear", while "caras" means "expensive".

translations.source: Farisa tana da nahawu mai sauki da na yau da kullum.
translations.reference: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.hypothesis: Iran has a simple and regular geography.

translations.source: Saboda haka, karanta wannan share fagen nahawun zai taimaka muku koya da yawa game da nahawun Farisanci da fahimtar jumla da kyau.
translations.reference: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
